a: Neeman lindarim, velacharamim, ulehekdeshot velaarachim, aval lo lemakkot velaonashin.

Mishna "kiddashti et bitti", "kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna", vahare hi ketanna – neeman. "kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna", vahare hi gedola – eno neeman. nishbet ufeditiha, ben shehi ketanna ben shehi gedola – eno neeman.
Gemara may shena resha umay shena sefa? resha bideh, sefa lav bideh.
Vela? vahare beyado lehassiah lechalal, deka fasla mikkehunna!
Ha la kashya, kerabbi dostay ben yehuda deamar: benot yisrael mikve tohora lachalalin.
Vahare beyado lehassiah lemamzer! kerabbi akiva deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin.

Hare beyado lehassiah almana lechohen gadol, ucherabbi simay, detanya, rabbi simay omer: min hakkol ose rabbi akiva mamzer, chutz mealmana lechohen gadol, shehare amra tora: "lo yikkach... velo yechallel": – chillulim ose, veen ose mamzerim.
Kerabbi yeshevav, deamar: bou venitzvavch al akiva ben yosef shehaya omer: kol sheen lo bia beyisrael havvalad mamzer.
Hanicha lerabbi yeshevav i letameh denafsheh – shappir. ella i leappoke mittama derabbi simay kaate, hare beyado lehassiah lechayyayve ase!
Amar rav ashe vetisbera resha mishshum divyado hu? nehi divyado lekaddeshah, beyado legarshah? veod, illu amar hay dela nicha [leh] begavva mi matze mekaddesh [la] nihaleh beal kurcheh?

Ella amar rav ashe: resha rachamana hemneh, kerav huna, deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin leav shenneeman leesor et bitto min hattora? shenneemar: "et bitti natatti laish hazze", "laish" – asarah, "hazze" – hittirah.
Benissuin hemneh rachamana leav, bishvuyay la hemneh.
Mishna mi sheamar bishat mitato "yesh li banim" – neeman. "yesh li achim" – eno neeman.
Gemara alma neeman lehattir veen neeman leesor. nema matnitin dela kerabbi natan,

Detanya: bishat kiddushin amar yesh lo banim, bishat mita amar en lo banim, bishat kiddushin amar en lo achim, bishat mita amar yesh lo achim – neeman lehattir veen neeman leesor, divre rabbi. rabbi natan omer: af neeman leesor.

Amar rava: shane hatam, kevan devishat mita ka hadar beh, ema kusheta kaamar. amar leh abbaye: velav kol dechen hu? hasheta, uma hatam deka mara leh ledibbureh, amrat kusheta kaamar, matnitin, dela ka mara leh ledibbureh, lo kol shekken?

Ella amar abbaye: matnitin dela muchezak lan beache vela muchezak lan bivne, deamrinan: kevan dela muchezak lan bivne vela beache amar: "yesh li banim" – neeman, "yesh li achim" – eno neeman. lav kol keminneh deasar la akkulle alma. barayyta
b: Demuchezak lan beache vela muchezak lan bivne, deamrinan: "ma li leshakker": may kaamar, lemiftera miyyavam? matze amar: patarna lich begitta.
Rabbi savar: "ma li leshakker" ki edim dame, veatu edim akri chazaka. verabbi natan savar: "ma li leshakker" ki chazaka dame, la atya chazaka veakra chazaka ligmare.

Mishna hamekaddesh et bitto setam – en habbogrot bakkelal. mi sheyyesh lo shete kitte vanot mishte nashim, veamar: "kiddashti et bitti haggedola, veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot, o gedola shebbakketannot, o ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedolot shebbakketannot" – kullan asurot chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: kullan muttarot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot.

"Kiddashti et bitti hakketanna, veeni yodea im ketanna shebbakketannot, o ketanna shebbaggedolot, o gedola shebbakketannot shehi ketanna min hakketannot shebbaggedolot" – kullan asurot chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: kullan muttarot, chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot.
Gemara ha ketannot bakkelal,
Shamat minna: kiddushin sheen mesurim levia, havu kiddushin! hacha bemay askinan, kesheen sham ella gedola uketanna.
Veha "bogrot" katane! may bogrot – bogrot dealma.

Peshita, bogrot may avidtayyhu? hacha bemay askinan, deshavviteh shaliach, mahu detema: ki mekabbel kiddushe addata dida ka mekabbel, ka mashma lan: la shavek inish midde deit leh hanaa minneh, veaved midde delet leh hanaa minneh.
Mi la askinan deamra leh: "kiddushayy lach"? afillu hachi, la shavek inish mitzva deramya aleh veaved mitzva dela ramya aleh.
Mi sheyyesh lo shete kitte vanot. utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta, behach kaamar rabbi meir dechevan deikka zutera minna lehach gedola kare la,
Aval beha, ema mode leh lerabbi yose diktanna" – lehach ketanna dechullehu kare la. vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yose, aval behach, ema mode leh lerabbi meir, tzericha.

Lememra derabbi meir savar: machet inish nafsheh lisfeka, verabbi yose savar: la machet inish lisfeka. vehaifka shaminan lehu, ditnan: hannoder "ad happesach" – asur ad sheyyaggia, "ad sheyyehe pesach" – asur ad sheyyetze,
"Ad pene fesach" – rabbi meir omer: asur ad sheyyaggia, rabbi yose omer: ad sheyyetze.
Amar rabbi chanina bar avdimi amar rav: muchelefet hashshita. vehatanya: ze hakkelal: kol shezzemanno kavua, veamar: "ad pene" – rabbi meir omer: ad sheyyatza, rabbi yose omer: ad sheyyaggia.
Amar abbaye: machaloket bishte kitte vanot, aval bechat achat – divre hakkol gedola mammash, ketanna mammash, emtzait bishmah kare la.
Amar leh rav adda bar matna leabbaye: ella meatta,

a: Emtzait shebbechat sheniyya tishtere! hacha bemay askinan, besheen sham ella gedola uketanna.
Vehachi name mistabbera, deim ita deikka, litneyay. uletamaych, emtzait shebbechat rishona, devadday sefeka vaasira leh, mi katane la?
Hachi hasheta?! hatam tanna ketanna dida leissura, vehu haddin lehach dekashshisha minna,
Hacha, im ita deikka – nitneyay.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: ha pesach, dechi chat achat dame, ufeligi!
Amar leh: hatam belishshana dealma kamippalgi. mar savar: "ad pene happesach" – ad kamme fischa, umar savar: ad demippene pischa.

Mishna haomer leishsha: "kiddashtich" vehi omeret: "lo kiddashtani" – hu asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav. hi omeret "kiddashtani" vehu omer "lo kiddashtich" – hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav.
"Kiddashtich" vehi omeret "lo kiddashta ella bitti" – hu asur bikrovot gedola ugedola mutteret bikrovav. hu muttar bikrovot ketanna uketanna mutteret bikrovav.
"Kiddashti et bittich" vehi omeret "lo kiddashta ella oti" – hu asur bikrovot ketanna uketanna mutteret bikrovav. hu muttar bikrovot gedola ugedola asura bikrovav.
Gemara haomer leishsha kiddashtich vechulei. utzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbeh dideh, mishshum degavra la ichpat leh umikkere amar.
Aval ihi, ema: i lav dekim la bedibbura, la havat amra, velittesar ihu bikrovoteha, ka mashma lan.
"Kiddashtich" vehi omeret vechulei. ha tu lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: middeorayyta hemneh rachamana leav, midderabbanan hemnuha ledida vetittesar beratta bedibbura, ka mashma lan.
"Kiddashti et bittich" vechulei. ha tu lema li? ayyeyde ditna ha, tena name ha.
Ittemar, rav amar: kofin, ushemuel amar: mevakkeshin. aheyay? illema aresha – lav "kofin" ikka vela "mevakkeshin" ikka! ella assefa.
Bishlama "mevakkeshin" – lechayye, ella "kofin" ammay?! amar: la nicha li deittesar bekariveha.
Ella: shematata ahadade ittemar, amar shemuel: mevakkeshin mimmennu litten get. amar rav: im natan get meatzmo – kofin oto litten ketubba.

Ittemar name: amar rav acha bar adda amar rav, veamri la amar rav acha bar adda amar rav hamenuna amar rav: kofin umevakkeshin. tarte?! hachi kaamar: mevakkeshin mimmennu litten get, veim natan meatzmo – kofin oto litten ketubba.

Amar rav yehuda: hamekaddesh beed echad – en choshshin lekiddushav. beo minneh merav yehuda: shenehem modim, may? in vela verafya bideh. ittemar, amar rav nachman amar shemuel: hamekaddesh beed echad – en choshshin lekiddushav, vaafillu shenehem modim.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman: haomer leishsha "kiddashtich" vehi omeret "lo kiddashtani" – hu asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav. i deikka edim – ammay mutteret bikrovav? vei delekka edim – ammay asur bikrovoteha? ella lav beed echad!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon daamar la "kiddashtich bifne peloni ufeloni", vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam.

Etiveh: hamegaresh et ishto velana immo befunedki, bet shammay omrim: enah tzericha hemennu get sheni, uvet hillel omrim: tzericha hemennu get sheni. hechi dame? i deikka edim – may tamayyhu devet shammay? vei delekka edim – may tamayyhu devet hillel? ella lav beed echad!
Velitamaych, ema sefa: umodim benitgarsha min haerusin sheen tzericha hemennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah. vei salka datach ed echad meheman – ma li min haerusin, ma li min hannissuin?
Ella, hacha bemay askinan – kegon deikka ede yichud velekka ede via. bet shammay savri: la
b: Amrinan hen hen ede yichud, hen hen ede via. uvet hillel savri: amrinan hen hen ede yichud, hen hen ede via. umodim vadday benitgarsha min haerusin, dela amrinan hen hen ede yichud hen hen ede via, mippene sheen libbo gas bah.

Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: hamekaddesh beed echad – en choshshin lekiddushav, vaafillu shenehem modim. amar rabba bar rav huna: hamekaddesh beed echad, be dina rabba amri: en choshshin lekiddushav. man be dina rabba? rav. veikka deamri: amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav. hamekaddesh beed echad, be dina rabba amri: en choshshin lekiddushav. man be dina rabba – rabbi.

Metiv rav achadvuy bar amme: shenayim shebbau mimmedinat hayyam veishsha immahem vachavila immahem, ze omer: zo ishti, veze avdi, vezo chavilati, veze omer: zo ishti, veze avdi, vezo chavilati. veishsha omeret: ellu shene avaday, vachavila shelli – tzericha shene gittin, vegova ketubbatah min hachavila.
Hechi dame? i deit leh sahade lehay veit leh sahade lehay, mi matzya[1] amra: ellu shene avaday vachavila shelli? ella lav beed echad!
Vetisbera? ed echad behachechasha mi meheman? ella: lemishre lealma, dechulle alma la peligi dishre,
Vehacha hachi kaamar: tzericha shene gittin – kede ligbot ketubbatah min hachavila. verabbi meir hi, deamar mittaltele mishtabedi lichtubba.
May have ala? rav kahana amar: en choshshin lekiddushav. rav pappa amar: choshshin lekiddushav. amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: may dataych – deyalfat "davar" "davar" mimmamon?
I ma lehallan hodaat baal din kemea edim dame, af kan hodaat baal din kemea edim dame. amar leh: hatam la ka chayev leacharine, hacha ka chayev leacharine.

Mar zutera verav adda sava bene derav mari bar issur pelug nichsayyhu bahade hadade. ato lekammeh derav ashe, amaru leh: "al pi shene edim" amar rachamana, dei bae lemihdar la matzu hadri behu, vaanan la hadri,
O dilma la mikkayyma milleta ella besahade? amar lehu: la ibbero sahade ella leshakkare.
Amar abbaye: amar lo ed echad "achalta chelev", vehalla shotek – neeman. vetanna tuna: amar lo ed echad "achalta chelev" vehalla omer "lo achalti" – patur. tama deamar "lo", ha ishtik – meheman.
Veamar abbaye: amar lo ed echad "nitmeu tohorotecha", vehalla shotek – neeman. vetanna tuna: ed echad omer "nitmeu" vehalla omer "lo nitmeu" – patur. tama deamar lo, ha ishtik – meheman.
Veamar abbaye: amar lo ed echad

a: "Shorcha nirba" vehalla shotek – neeman, vetanna tuna: veshenneevda bo avera, veshehemit al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim – neeman. hay "al pi ed echad", hechi dame? i deka modu bealim, hayeynu "al pi habbealim", ella lav deshatek?
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta, i lav dekim leh benafsheh daavad – chullin baazara la hava mayyte.
Aval "nitmeu tohorotecha" – memar amrinan: hay deshatek – desavar, chaze leh bime tumeato.
Vei ashmeinan ha, mishshum deka mafsed leh bime tohorato, aval "shoro nirba" memar amar: kol hshvorim lav legabbe mizbeach kayymi, tzericha.
Ibbaya lehu: ishto zinneta bead echad veshotek, mahu? amar abbaye: neeman. rava amar: eno neeman. have davar shebbeerva, veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim.

Amar abbaye: mena amena la, dehahu samya dahava mesaddar matneyayta kammeh demar shemuel. yoma chad nega leh vela hava kaate. shaddar shelicha abbatreh. addeazel sheliach bachada orcha, ata ihu bachada. ki ata shaliach, amar: ishto zinneta. ata lekammeh demar shemuel, amar leh: i meheman lach – zil appeka, vei la – la tappek.
May lav i meheman alach delav gazlana hu? verava: i meheman lach keve tere – zil appeka, vei la – la tappeka.

Veamar abbaye: mena amena la, detanya: maase binay hammelech shehalach lechuchelit shebbammidbar, vechibbesh sham shishshim kerakkim, uvachazarato haya sameach simcha gedola. vekara lechol chachme yisrael, amar lahem: avotenu hayu ochlim meluchim bizman shehayu asukim bevinyan bet hammikdash, af anu nochal meluchim zecher laavotenu. veheelu meluchim al shulechanot shel zahav, veachlu.

Vehaya sham echad, ish letz lev ra uveliyyaal, veelazar ben poera shemo. vayyomer elazar ben poera leyannay hammelech: yannay hammelech, libbam shel perushim alecha. uma eese? hakem lahem batztzitz shebben enecha. hekim lahem batztzitz shebben enav.

Haya sham zaken echad vihuda ben gedidya shemo, vayyomer yehuda ben gedidya leyannay hammelech: yannay hammelech! rav lecha keter malchut, hannach keter kehunna lezaro shel aharon. shehayu omrim: immo nishbet bemodiim. vayvukkash haddavar velo nimtza. vayyibbadlu chachme yisrael bezaam.

Vayyomer elazar ben poera leyannay hammelech: yannay hammelech, hedyot shebbeyisrael kach hu dino, veatta melech vechohen gadol kach hu dinach? uma eese? im atta shomea laatzati: romsem. vetora ma tehe aleha? hare kerucha umunnachat bekeren zavit, kol harotze lilmod yavo veyilmod.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: miyyad nizreka bo minut, dahava leh lememar: tinach tora shebbichtav, tora shebbeal pe may? miyyad: vattutzatz haraa al yede elazar ben poera, vayyehargu kol chachme yisrael, vehaya haolam mishtomem, ad shebba shimon ben shatach vehechzir et hattora leyoshnah.
Hechi dame? illema deve tere amri: "ishtevay" uve tere amri: "la ishtevay" – may chazet desamchat ahane, semoch ahane!
Ella beed echad, vetama deka machchashi leh be tere, ha lav hachi meheman.
Verava: leolam tere utere, vechidamar rav acha bar rav minyome: beede hazama. hacha name, beede hazama.
Veibbaet ema kidrabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: shifcha hichnisu tachteha.
Amar rava:
b: Mena amena la, ditnan: amar rabbi shimon: maase bimgora shel diskim beyavne shehayta omedet bechezkat shelema, umaddu venimtzet chasera –

Kol teharot shennaasu al gabbah haya rabbi tarfon metaher, verabbi akiva metamme. amar rabbi tarfon: mikve ze bechezkat shalem hu omed, missafek atta ba lechassero – al techasserennu missafek. amar rabbi akiva: adam ze bechezkat tame hu omed, missafek atta ba letaharo – al tetaharennu missafek.

Amar rabbi tarfon: mashal leomed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach, venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza, sheavodato keshera. amar rabbi akiva: mashal leomed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach venoda shehu baal mum, sheavodato pesula.

Amar rabbi tarfon: atta dimmito levaal mum, vaani dimmitiv leven gerusha o leven chalutza, nire lemi dome. i dome leven gerusha uleven chalutza – nedunennu keven gerusha o keven chalutza, im dome levaal mum – nedunennu kevaal mum.
Hitchil rabbi akiva ladun: mikve pesulo beyachid, uvaal mum pesulo beyachid, veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo bishnayim.
Davar acher: mikve pesulo begufo, baal mum pesulo begufo, veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo meacherim. amar leh rabbi tarfon: akiva! kol happoresh mimmecha keforesh min hachayyim.
Hay baal mum sheppesulo beyachid hechi dame? i deka machchesh leh, mi meheman? ella deshatek,
Vedichvateh gabbe ben gerusha uven chalutza deshatek, vekatane: mikve pesulo beyachid uvaal mum pesulo beyachid, veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo bishnayim.

Veabbaye amar: leolam deka machchesh leh, udekaamrat: 'ammay meheman – deamar leh: shelach achvi. vehayeynu dekatane: mikve pesulo begufo uvaal mum pesulo begufo, veal yochiach ben gerusha uven chalutza sheppesulo meacherim.
Uven gerusha uven chalutza daavodato keshera, menalan? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: deamar kera: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav" – ben zera kasher uven zera pasul.
Avu dishmuel amar: mehacha: "barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze" – afillu chullin shebbo tirtze.
Rabbi yannay amar: mehacha: "uvata el hakkohen asher yihye bayyamim hahem", vechi taale al datecha sheadam holech etzel kohen shello haya beyamav? ella ze kasher venitchallel.

Baal mum daavodato pesula, menalan? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: deamar kera: "lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom" – keshehu shalem velo keshehu chaser. veha "shalom" ketiv! amar rav nachman: vav deshalom ketia hi.
Mishna kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veen avera – havvalad holech achar hazzachar. veeze zo – zo kohenet, leviyya, veyisreelit shennisseu lechohen, levi, veyisrael.

Vechol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veyesh avera – havvalad holech achar happagum. veeze zo – zo almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin.

Vechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin, aval yesh lah al acherim kiddushin – havvalad mamzer. veeze ze – ze habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora. vechol mi sheen lah lo alav velo al acherim kiddushin – havvalad kemotah. veeze ze – ze velad shifcha venochrit.
Gemara kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin. amar leh rabbi shimon lerabbi yochanan: kelala hu dechol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veen avera havvalad holech achar hazzachar? hare

a: Ger shennasa mamzeret, deyesh kiddushin veen avera – havvalad holech achar happagum, detanya: ger shennasa mamzeret – havvalad mamzer, divre rabbi yose! amar leh: mi savrat matnitin rabbi yose hi? matnitin rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: ger lo yissa mamzeret, veyesh kiddushin veyesh avera – havvalad holech achar happagum.
Venitneyay! tena "kol makom" desefa, leetoye.
Veibbaet ema: leolam rabbi yose hi, utena "ezo zo" lemaote.
"Veezo zo" vetu la? vahare chalal shennasa bat yisrael, deyesh kiddushin veen avera – havvalad holech achar hazzachar! ha la kashya, kerabbi dostay ben rabbi yehuda sevira leh.
Vahare yisrael shennasa chalala, deyesh kiddushin veen avera – havvalad holech achar hazzachar! tena "kol makom" deresha, leetoye.
Venitneyay behedya! mishshum dela mittene le. hechi nitne? kohenet uleviyya veyisreelit vachalala shennisset lechohen levi veyisrael – vachalala lechohen mi chazya?
Vehaikka derabba bar bar chana, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona – benah shelishi have!
Tena "kol makom" deresha, leetoye. ulerav dimi deamar sheni have, tena "ezo zo" lemaote.
Vehaikka, dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: baummot – hallech achar hazzachar.
Nitgayyeyru, hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem. tena "ezo zo" lemaote.
Hay may? i amrat bishlama matnitin rabbi yehuda hi, "kol makom" deresha – leetoye yisrael shennasa chalala, uderabba bar bar chana, "ezo zo" – lemaote derav dimi veravin!
b: "Kol makom" desefa – leetoye ger shennasa mamzeret. ella i amrat rabbi yose hi, "kol makom" deresha – kedaamaran, "ezo zo" – kedaamaran, ella "kol makom" desefa leetoye may?
Uletamaych, lerabbi yehuda "ezo zo" desefa lema li? ella: ayyeyde ditna resha "ezo zo", tena sefa "ezo zo". hachi name ayyeyde ditna resha "kol makom", tena name sefa "kol makom".
Gufa: ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: baummot – hallech achar hazzachar. nitgayyeyru – hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem.
May "baummot hallech achar hazzachar"? kidtanya: minnayin leechad min haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved?

Talmud lomar: "vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu". yachol af eved shebba al shifcha min haummot veholid ben sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved? talmud lomar: "asher holidu beartzechem" – min hannoladin beartzechem, velo min haggarim beartzechem.
"Nitgayyeyru hallech achar happagum shebbishnehem" – bemay? ilema bemitzri shennasa ammonit, may pagum ikka, "ammoni" – velo ammonit!
Ella beammoni shennasa mitzrit, vei zachar have – hay shidye abbatreh dideh, veim nekeva havya – shidya abbatra dida.

Kol sheen lah alav kiddushin. mena hane mille? deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan umatu bah mishshum derabbi yannay, verav acha bereh derava umatu bah mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: amar kera: "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher" – laacherim velo likrovim.
Matkef la rabbi abba: veema "leacher" velo leven! ben behedya ketiv beh: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv", "acher" lema li? shema minna laacherim velo likrovim.
Veema: idde veidde leven, ha – lechattechilla, veha – diavad.
Lechattechilla meachot ishsha nafka: uma achot ishsha, becharet la tafsi ba kiddushin, chayyayve mitot bet din lo kol shekken?
Veema: idde veidde baachot ishsha, ha – lechattechilla, ha – diavad! in hachi name.

Ashkechan achot ishsha, shear arayot menalan? yalfinan meachot ishsha: ma achot ishsha meyuchedet, shehi erva vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat – vela tafsi bah kiddushin, af kol shehi erva vechayyayvin al zedonah karet veal shiggatah chattat – la tafsi bah kiddushin.
Bishlama kullehu atyayn, ella eshet ish veeshet ach – ikka lemifrach: ma laachot ishsha, shekken en lah hetter bimkom mitzva – tomar beeshet ach sheyyesh lah hetter bimkom mitzva.
Eshet ish name ikka lemifrach: ma lehanach, shekken en lah hetter bechayye osran – tomar beeshet ish sheyyesh lah hetter bechayye osran!

Ella amar rabbi yona veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: amar kera: "kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu", hukeshu kol haarayot kullam laachot ishsha, ma achot ishsha lo tafsi bah kiddushin – af kol arayot kullam lo tafsi bah kiddushin.
I hachi,

a: Afillu nidda name! allema amar abbaye: hakkol modim beva al hannidda veal hassota, sheen havvalad mamzer? amar chizkiyya: amar kera "utehi niddatah alav", afillu bishat niddatah – tehe bah havaya.
Mikkede ikka leakkosha lenidda, veikka leakkosha laachot ishsha, may chazet demakkeshat lehu laachot ishsha? akkesha lenidda! kulla vechumera – lechumera makkeshinan.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: atya bekal vachomer mivama: uma yevama, shehi belav – la tafsi bah kiddushin, chayyayve mitot vechayyayve charetot lo kol shekken? i hachi, shear chayyayve lavin name!

Amar rav pappa: chayyayve lavin behedya ketiv behu – "ki tihyena leish shete nashim haachat ahuva vehaachat senua", vechi yesh senua lifne hammakom vaahuva lifne hammakom? ella: "ahuva" – ahuva benissueha, "senua" – senua benissueha. vekaamar rachamana: "ki tihyena".
Ulerabbi akiva deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin, "ki tihyena" bemay mokem? bealmana lechohen gadol, ucherabbi simay.
Detanya, rabbi simay omer: min hakkol haya rabbi akiva ose mamzer chutz mealmana lechohen gadol, shehare amra tora: "lo yechallel" – chillulim ose, veen ose mamzerut.
Ulerabbi yeshevav, deamar: bou venitzvavch al akiva ben yosef shehaya omer: kol sheen lo bia beyisrael – havvalad mamzer? hanicha lerabbi yeshevav i leappoke midderabbi simay kaate – shappir.
Ella i tama denafsheh kaamar, vaafillu chayyayve ase, bemay mokem la?
Bivula lechohen gadol. umay shena? mishshum dehave leh ase sheen shave bakkol.
Verabbanan, addemoke la bechayyayve lavin, nokma bechayyayve ase!
Hane chayyayve ase, bemay ninhu? i shetehen mitzriyyot – shetehen senuot, i achat mitzrit veachat yisreelit – shete nashim meam echad baenan, i beula lechohen gadol – mi ketiv "tihyena lechohen"?
Verabbi akiva? beal kurechech shivkeh likra dehave dachek, umoke annafsheh.
Vechol mi sheen lah alav vechulei. shifcha kenaanit menalan? amar rav huna: amar kera: "shevu lachem po im hachamor" – am haddome lachamor. ashkechan dela tafsi ba kiddushe,
b: Veladah kemotah menalan? deamar kera: "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".
Nochrit menalan? amar kera: "lo titchatten bam". ashkachna dela tafsi ba kiddushe, veladah kemotah menalan?
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: deamar kera: "ki yasir et bincha meacharay" – bincha habba miyyisreelit karuy bincha, veen bincha habba min hannochrit karuy bincha, ella benah.
Amar ravina: shema minna: ben bittecha habba min hannochri – karuy bincha. nema kasavar ravina nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael – havvalad mamzer?
Nehi dechasher la have, mamzer la have, pasul mikkere.
Hahu beshiva goyim ketiv, shear ummot menalan? amar kera: "ki yasir et bincha" – lerabbot kol hammesirim.
Hanicha lerabbi shimon, dedaresh tama dikra. ella lerabbanan, may tama?
Amar kera: "veachar ken tavo eleha uvealtah vegomer" – mikkelal demeikkara la tafsi ba kiddushin.

Ashkechan dela tafsi ba kiddushin, veladah kemotah menalan? amar kera: "ki tihyena leish... veyaldu lo" – kol hecha dekarenan beh "ki tihyena", karenan beh "veyaldu lo". vechol hecha dela karenan beh "ki tihyena" – la karenan beh "veyaldu lo".
I hachi, shifcha name! in hachi name. ella "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha" lema li? lechidtanya:

a: Haomer leshifchato: "hare at bat chorin, uveladich eved" – havvalad kemotah, divre rabbi yose haggelili. vachachamim omrim: devarav kayyaymim, mishshum shenneemar: "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".
May talmuda? amar rava: adderabbi yose haggelili.
Mishna rabbi tarfon omer: yecholin mamzerin littaher. ketzad? mamzer shennasa shifcha, havvalad – eved, shichrero – nimtza habben ben chorin. rabbi eliezer omer: hare ze eved mamzer.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbi tarfon lechattechilla kaamar, o diavad kaamar? ta shema: amru lo lerabbi tarfon: tiharta et hazzecharim, velo tiharta et hannekevot.
Vei amrat lechattechilla kaamar, mamzeret name tinnesiv leavda! eved en lo chayis.
Ta shema: deushepizkaneh derabbi simlay mamzer hava, vaamar leh: i akdemtach – tahartinhu livnach. i amrat bishlama lechattechilla – shappir, ella i amrat diavad, may nihu?

Demansev leh etza veamar leh: zil genov veizdabban beeved ivri. uvishne derabbi simlay eved ivri mi hava? vehaamar mar: in eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg! ella lav shema minna rabbi tarfon lechattechilla kaamar – shema minna. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hare ze eved mamzer. amar rabbi elazar: may tameh derabbi eliezer – deamar kera: "lo" – hallech achar pesulo.
Verabbanan: hahu beyisrael shennasa mamzeret. salka datach amena: "lemishpechotam levet avotam" ketiv, ata "lo" appekeh.

Verabbi eliezer: lav af al gav dichtav "lemishpechotam levet avotam" ata "lo" appekeh, hacha name af al gav dichtiv "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha", ata "lo" appekeh. verabbanan: kol valad bime shifcha kenaanit kevalad bime behema dame.
Hadaran alach haomer
Asara yuchasim alu mibbavel: kahane, leviyye, yisreele, chalale, gere, vacharore, mamzere, netine, shetuke, vaasufe.
Kahane leviyye veyisreele – muttarin lavo ze baze. leviyye yisreele chalale gere vacharori – muttarin lavo ze baze.

Gire vacharore mamzere unetine shetuke vaasufe – kullam muttarin lavo ze baze. veellu hem: shetuki kol shehu makkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv, asufi – kol shenneesaf min hashshuk, veeno makkir lo et aviv velo immo. abba shaul haya kore lashshetuki: "beduki".

Gemara asara yuchasin alu mibbavel. may irya detane "alu mibbavel"? nitne "halchu leeretz yisrael"! milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, kidtanya: "vekamta vealita el hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha", melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoah mikkol eretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot.
Bishlama bet hammikdash gavoah mikkol eretz yisrael – hayeynu dichtiv:
b: "Divre rivot bisharecha vekamta vealita", ella eretz yisrael gevoha mikkol aratzot menalan? dichtiv: "lachen hinne yamim baim neum Adonai velo yomru od chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim. ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham".
May irya detane "alu mibbavel"? nitne "alu leeretz yisrael"! mesayyay leh lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: lo ala ezra mibbavel ad sheasaah kesolet nekiyya veala.
Ittemar abbaye amar: "alu" – meelehem, tenan. verava amar: "heelum" tenan. vekamippalgi bidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: lo ala ezra mibbavel ad sheasaah kesolet nekiyya veala.

Abbaye – let leh derabbi elazar. rava – it leh derabbi elazar. ibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu derabbi elazar, vehacha beha ka mippalgi: mar savar: afroshe afroshinhu uminnafshayyhu seliku, umar savar: beal kurchayyhu assokinhu.

Bishlama leman deamar: "alu", hayeynu deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol aratzot issa leeretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael issa levavel. ella leman deamar: "heelum", midda yadinhu! nehi deyadi lehahu dara, ledara acharine la yadi.
Bishlama leman deamar "alu", hayeynu dichtiv: "vaekbetzem el hannahar habba al achava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina vaam uvakkohanim umibbene levi lo matzati sham".
Ella leman deamar "heelum", ha mizhar zehiri? nehi deizzehur bifsulim, bichsherim la izdehur.
Kahane leviyye veyisreele. menalan disliku? dichtiv: "vayyeshvu hakkohanim vehaleviyyim umin haam vehameshorrim vehashshoarim vehannetinim bearehem vechol yisrael bearehem".

Chalale gere vacharore. chalale menalan? detanya, rabbi yose omer: gedola chazaka, shenneemar: "umibbene hakkohanim bene chovayya bene hakkotz bene varzillay asher lakach mibbenot barzillay haggiladi ishsha vayyikkare al shemam. elle bikshu chetavam hammityachsim velo nimtzau vaygoalu min hakkehunna. vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim ad amod kohen leurim uletummim".
Veamar lahem: hare attem bechezkatchem. bamme heyitem ochlim baggola, bekodshe haggevul? af kan name, bekodshe haggevul.
Uleman deamar: maalim mitteruma leyuchasin? hane daachul bitruma atu leassokinhu! shane hatam, deria chezkatayyhu.
Veella may gedola chazaka? demeikkara achul bitruma derabbanan, ulevassof achul bitruma deorayyta.
Veibbaet ema: leolam hasheta name bidrabbanan – achul, bidorayyta – la achul, vechi massekinan mitteruma leyuchasin – middeorayyta, midderabbanan la massekinan.
I hachi, may gedola chazaka? demeikkara lekka lemigzar mishshum teruma deorayyta, levassof – af al gav deikka lemigzar mishshum teruma deorayyta, bidrabbanan – achul, bidorayyta – la achul.
Vehachtiv "vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim" – bekodesh hakkadashim hu delo yochl[u], ha kol midde nechol!

Hachi kaamar: la midde demikkere kodesh, vela midde demikkere kadashim. la midde demikkere kodesh – dichtiv: "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh", vela midde demikkere kadashim, deamar kera "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel", veamar mar: "bammuram min hakkodashim

a: Lo tochel".
"Gere vacharore". menalan? amar rav chisda, deamar kera: "vechol hannivdal mittumat goye haaretz alehem".

Mamzere. menalan? dichtiv "vayyishma sanvallat hachoroni vetoviyya haeved haammoni", uchetiv: "ki rabbim bihuda baale shevua lo ki chatan hu lishchanya ven arach vihochanan beno lakach et bat meshullam ben berechya", kasavar nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael – havvalad mamzer.

Hanicha leman deamar: havvalad mamzer, ella leman deamar: havvalad kasher, may ikka lememar? vetu: mimmay dahavo leh bene? dilma la havo leh bene! vetu: mimmay dehacha havo lehu useliku? dilma hatam havo!

Ella mehacha: "veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha keruv addon veimmer, velo yachlu lehaggid bet avotam vezaram im miyyisrael hem", "tel melach" – ellu bene adam sheddomim maasehem lemaase sedom shennehefcha letel melach. "tel charsha" – ze shekkore "abba" veimmo meshattakto.

"Velo yachlu lehaggid bet avotam vezaram im miyyisrael hem" – ze hu asufi shenneesaf min hashshuk. "keruv addon veimmer" – amar rabbi avahu: amar adon: ani amarti yihyu yisrael lefanay chashuvim kichruv vehem samu atzmam kenamer. ikka deamri amar rabbi avahu: amar adon: af al pi shessamu atzmam kenamer – hen chashuvim lefanay kichruv.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, maale alav hakkatuv keillu charasho lechol haolam kullo uzerao melach, shenneemar: "veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha".
Amar rabba bar rav adda amar rav: kol hannose ishsha leshum mamon – havayin lo banim sheenan mehugganim, shenneemar: "baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu".

Veshemma tomar mamon palet, talmud lomar: "atta yochlem chodesh et chelkehem". veshemma tomar: "chelko" – velo chelkah, talmud lomar: "chelkehem". veshemma tomar lizman merubbe – talmud lomar: "chodesh". may mashma? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chodesh nichnas vechodesh yatza umamonam avad.

Veamar rabba bar rav adda veamri la amar rabbi salla amar rav hamenuna: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo. vetana: al kullam eliyyahu kotev vehakkadosh baruch hu chotem: oy lo lapposel et zaro, velappogem et mishpachto, velannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, eliyyahu kofto vehakkadosh baruch hu rotzo.
Vechol happosel – pasul. veeno medabber bishvacha leolam, veamar shemuel: bemumo posel.

Hahu gavra deminnehardea deal leve matbechayya befumebdita. amar lehu: havu li bisra. amaru leh: netar ad deshakel (l)shammaeh derav yehuda bar yechezkel venittev lach. amar: man yehuda bar sheviskel dekadem li, deshakel min kammay?! azalu amaru leh lerav yehuda. shammeteh. amaru: regil dekare inashe "avde". achrez aleh deavda hu.

Azal hahu azmeneh ledina lekammeh derav nachman. ayyti pitka dehazmana. azal rav yehuda lekammeh derav huna. amar leh: ezil o la ezil? amar leh: mezal la mibbee lach lemezal, mishshum degavra rabba at, ella mishshum yekara deve nesia kum zil.

Ata ashkecheh dekaaved maake. amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav huna bar idi amar shemuel: kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur asur baasiyyayt melacha bifne shelosha? amar leh: pureta degunedrita hu deka avedna. amar leh: mi sene "maake" dichtiv beorayyta, o "mechitza" daamur rabbanan?

Amar leh: yetiv mar akkarpita. amar leh: umi sene "safsal" daamur rabbanan, o "itzteva" deamri inashe? amar leh: lechol mar etrunega. amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: kol haomer "etrunega" tilta beramut rucha – o "etrog" kidkaryu rabbanan, o "etroga" deamri inashe. amar leh: lishte mar anbaga. amar leh: mi sene "isparagos" dekaryu rabbanan o "anpak" deamri inashe?
Amar leh: tete donag tashkenan. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: en mishtammeshim beishsha. ketanna hi. beferush amar shemuel: en mishtammeshim beishsha kelal, ben gedola ben ketanna.
Neshaddar leh mar shelama leyalta. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol baishsha erva. efshar al yede shaliach. amar leh: hachi amar shemuel:
b: En shoalin bishlom ishsha. al yede balah! amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: en shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal. shelacha leh devethu: sheri leh tigreh dela nishavvevyach kishar am haaretz.

Amar leh: may sheyateh demar hacha? amar leh: taska dehazmanuta shaddar mar abbatray. amar leh: hasheta shuta demar la gemirna, taska dehazmanuta meshaddarna lemar?! appek diska dehazmanuta mibbe chadeh veachzi leh, amar leh: ha gavra veha diska. amar leh: hoil vaata mar lehacha lishtae milleh ki hechi dela lemru mechannefi rabbanan ahadade.
Amar leh: may tama shammeteh mar lehahu gavra? – tzayar shelicha derabbanan. venaggedeh mar, derav menagged al man dimtzaar shelucha derabbanan. daadif minneh avadi leh.

May tama achrez mar aleh deavda hu? amar leh: dirgil dekare inashe "avde", vetane: kol happosel – pasul, veeno medabber bishvacha leolam. veamar shemuel: bemumo posel. emar deamar shemuel lemechash leh, leachroze aleh mi amar?

Addehachi vehachi (ata hahu bar dineh minnehardae). amar leh hahu bar dineh lerav yehuda: ledidi karet li "avda", deatena mibbet chashmonay malka?! amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol deamar middevet chashmonay kaatena – avda hu.

Amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva, im kodem maase amarah – shomin lo, veim lav – en shomin lo? amar leh: ha ikka rav matna dekae kevoti.

Rav matna la chazyay linhardea telesar shene. hahu yoma ata. amar leh: dechir mar may amar shemuel ki kae chada kara aggudda vachada kara bemabbara? amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: kol deamar middevet chashmonay malka kaatena – avda hu, dela ishteyur minnayyhu ella hahi revita desalka leiggara veramya kala veamra: kol deamar mibbet chashmonay ana – avda hu.
Nefala meiggara umita. achruz aleh deavda hu.

Hahu yoma ikkaran kamma ketubbata binhardea. ki ka nafek, nafki abbatreh lemirgemeh. amar lehu: i (shetiku) [shatkitu] – shetiku, vei la megallena alayychu ha deamar shemuel tarte zarayayta ikka binhardea: chada mikkarya deve yona, vachada mikkarya deve oravti. vesimanaych: tame – tame, tahor – tahor. shadyu lehahu rigma midayyhu vekam atma binhar malka.

Machriz rav yehuda befumebdita: adda veyonatan – avde. yehuda bar pappa – mamzera, bati bar toviyya beramut rucha la shakel gitta decheruta. machrez rava bemachoza: ballae, dannae, tallae, mallae, zaggae – kullam lifsul. amar rav yehuda: govae – givonae, durenunita – darae netinae. amar rav yosef: hay be chubbe defumebdita – kullam deavde.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: arba meot avadim, veamri la arbaat alafim avadim hayu lo lefashchur ben immer, vechullam nitmeu bakkehunna. vechol kohen sheyyesh bo azzut panim eno ella mehem. amar abbaye: kullehu yatvan beshura devinhardea. ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: im raita kohen beazzut metzach – al teharher acharav, shenneemar: "veammecha kimrive chohen".

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rav: kol hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, keshehakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato meid al kol hashshevatim veen meid alav, shenneemar: "shivte yah edut leyisrael", ematay have edut leyisrael – bizman shehashshevatim shivte yah.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: keshehakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato – en mashre ella al mishpachot meyuchasot shebbeyisrael, shenneemar: "baet hahi neum Adonai ehye lelohim lechol mishpechot yisrael", "lechol yisrael" lo neemar, ella "lechol mishpechot".

"[Vehemma] yihyu li leam", amar rabba bar rav huna: zo maala yetera yesh ben yisrael legerim. deillu beyisrael ketiv behu: "vehayiti lahem lelohim vehemma yihyu li leam", veillu begerim ketiv: "mi hu ze arav et libbo lageshet elay neum Adonai. vihyitem li leam veanochi ehye lachem lelohim".
Amar rabbi chelbo: kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat, shenneemar: "venilva hagger alehem venispechu al bet yaakov" – ketiv hacha "venispechu", uchetiv hatam "lasseet velassappachat".
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: keshehakkadosh baruch hu

a: Metaher shevatim, shivto shel levi metaher techilla, shenneemar: "vayyeshev metzaref umetaher kesef vetihar et bene levi vezikkak otam kazzahav vechakkasef vehayu laAdonai maggishe mincha bitzdaka".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kesef metaher mamzerim, shenneemar: "vayyeshev metzaref umetaher kesef". may "maggishe mincha bitzdaka"? amar rabbi yitzchak: tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu im yisrael, shemmishpacha shennitmea – nitmea.

Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol aratzot issa leeretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael issa levavel. bime rabbi bikkeshu laasot bavel issa leeretz yisrael. amar lahen: kotzim attem mesimim li ben enay? retzonchem, yittafel immachem rabbi chanina bar chama.
Nitpal immahem rabbi chanina bar chama, amar lahem: kach mekubbelani merabbi yishmael berabbi yose sheamar mishshum aviv: kol aratzot issa leeretz yisrael veeretz yisrael issa levavel.

Bime rabbi pinchas bikkeshu laasot bavel issa leeretz yisrael. amar lahem laavadav: kesheani omer shene devarim bevet hammidrash teluni baarisa verutzu. ki ayel amar lahem: en shechita laof min hattora.

Addeyatvi vekamayyeyni ba, amar lehu: kol aratzot issa leeretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael issa levavel. netaluhu baarisa veratzu. ratzu acharav velo higgiuhu. yashvu uvadku ad shehiggiu lesakkana ufershu.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hechla, beyadenu hi, aval ma eese shehare gedole haddor nitmeu bah. savar la kerabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: mishpacha shennitmea – nitmea.

Amar abbaye: af anan name tenena: mishpachat bet hatztzerifa hayta beever hayyarden verichakah ben tziyyon bizroa. od acheret hayta vekervah ben tziyyon bizroa. kegon ellu – eliyyahu ba letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev – kegon ellu deyadin, aval mishpacha shennitmea – nitmea.

Tana: od acheret hayta, velo ratzu chachamim legallotah. aval chachamim mosrim oto livnehem uletalmidehen paam achat beshavua, veamri la paamayim beshavua. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera keman deamar paam achat beshavua. kidtanya: "hareni nazir im lo agalle mishpachot" – yihye nazir, velo yegalle mishpachot.

Amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: shem ben arba otiyyot chachamim mosrin oto letalmidehen paam achat beshavua, veamri la paamayim beshavua. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera keman deamar paam achat beshavua, dichtiv: "ze shemi leolam", "leallem" ketiv. rava savar lemidresheh befirka. amar leh hahu sava: "leallem" ketiv.
Rabbi avina rame: ketiv "ze shemi", uchetiv "ze zichri". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo kesheani nichtav ani nikra, nichtav ani beyod he venikra bealef dalet.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona, shem ben shetem esre otiyyot hayu mosrin oto lechol adam, mishsherabbu happaritzim – hayu mosrim oto litznuim shebbakkehunna, vehatztzenuim shebbakkehunna mavliim oto binimat achehem hakkohanim. tanya amar rabbi tarfon: paam achat aliti achar achi immi ladduchan, vehitteti azni etzel kohen gadol veshamati shehivlia shem binimat echav hakkohanim.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shem ben arbaim ushetayim otiyyot en mosrin oto ella lemi shetztzanua veanav, veomed bachatzi yamav, veeno koes, veeno mishtakker, veeno maamid al middotav. vechol hayyodo, vehazzahir bo vehameshammero betohora – ahuv lemala, venechmad lematta, veemato muttelet al habberiyyot, venochel shene olamim – haolam hazze vehaolam habba.

Amar shemuel mishshemeh desava: bavel bechezkat keshera omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nifsela. shear aratzot – bechezkat pesul hen omdot, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nichshera. eretz yisrael muchezak lefasul – pasul, muchezak lechasher – kasher.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat muchezak lefasul – pasul. ha setama – kasher. vahadar tane: muchezak lechasher – kasher. ha setama – pasul! amar rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav: la kashya,
b: Kan – lehassio ishsha, kan – lehotzi ishsha miyyado.
Amar rav yosef: kol shessichato bevavel, massiin lo ishsha. vehaiddana deikka rammae, chayyshinan.

Zeeri hava ka mishtemit minneh derabbi yochanan dahava amar leh: nesev beratti. yoma chad havo kaazli beorcha, meto leurekma demayya, arkeveh lerabbi yochanan akkatpeh veka meabbar leh. amar leh: orayytan keshera, benatin la kesheran? may dataych,

Illema midditnan: asara yuchasin alu mibbavel kahane leviyye – attu kahane leviyye veyisreele kullehu seliku? ki hechi deishteyur mehane ishteyur name mehane! ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi elazar: lo ala ezra mibbavel ad sheasaah kesolet nekiyyay veala.

Ulla ikkela lefumebdita leve rav yehuda, chazyeh lerav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda degadel vela nasev. amar leh: may tama la ka mansev leh mar itteta livreh? amar leh: mi yadana mehecha ensevay? amar leh: attu anan mi yadinan mehecha kaatenan? dilma mehanach dichtiv: "nashim betziyyon innu betulot beare yehuda".

Vechi tema nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad kasher, vedilma mehanach dichtiv behu: "hashshochvim al mittot shen useruchim al arsotam". veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: ellu bene adam hammashtinim mayim bifne mittotehem arummim.
Umegaddef ba rabbi avahu: i hachi hayeynu dichtiv: "lachen atta yiglu berosh golim" – mishshum demashtinim mayim bifne mittotehem arummim, "yiglu berosh golim".
Ella amar rabbi avahu: ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin ze im ze, umadbikin mittotehem zo bazo, umachalifin neshotehem ze laze, umasrichim arsotam beshichvat zera sheenah shellahem.
Amar leh: hechi naaved? amar leh: zil batar shetikuta, ki hay devadki bene mareva: ki minnetzu be tere bahade hadade chazu he minnayyhu dekadem veshatek – amri: hay meyuchas tefe.
Amar rav: shetikuteh devavel – hayeynu yichusa. ini? veha ikkela rav leve bar shafe challa uvedak behu, may lav beyachasuta? la, bishtikuta. hachi kaamar lehu: beduku i shatki i la shatki.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: im raita shene bene adam shemmitgarim ze baze – shemetz pesul yesh beechad mehen, veen mannichin oto liddabbek echad bachavero. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: im raita shete mishpachot hammitgarot zo bazo – shemetz pesul yesh beachat mehen, veen mannichin otah liddabbek bachavertah.
Amar rav pappa sava mishshemeh derav: bavel – beria. meshon – meta. maday – chola. elam – goseset. uma ben cholin legossin? rov cholin lechayyim, rov gossim lemita.

Ad hechan hi bavel? rav amar: ad nahar azak, ushemuel amar: ad nehar yuani. leel bediglat ad hecha? rav amar: ad bagda veavvna. ushemuel amar: ad mushekne. velo mushekne bakkelal? vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar shemuel: mushekne hare hi kaggola leyuchasin! ella: ad mushekne, umushekne bakkelal.

Letachtit bediglat ad hecha? amar rav shemuel: ad appameyay tattaa. tarte appameyay havyayn: chada illita vachada tattayyta, chada keshera vachada pesula, uven chada lachada parsa, veka kafdi ahadade vaafillu nura la moshli ahadade. vesimanaych difsuleta ha demishtaaya meshanit.
Leel bifrat ad hecha? rav amar: ad akra detulebakne. ushemuel amar: ad gishra deve ferat. verabbi yochanan amar: ad maabbarta[1] degizma. layet abbaye veittema rav yosef adderav.
Adderav layet, addishmuel la layet? ella layet adderav, vechol shekken addishmuel. veibbaet ema: leolam adderav layet, addishmuel la layet, vegishra deve ferat letattay hava kae.

a: Vehaiddana hu [d]dalyu parsae. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: leha gisa difrat ad hecha? amar leh: may dataych? mishshum biram? meyaychasi defumebdita mibbiram nasvi.
Amar rav pappa: kemachloket leyuchasin, kach machloket leinyan gittin. verav yosef amar: machloket leyuchasin, aval legittin – divre hakkol ad arba tinyayna degishra.

Amar rame bar abba: chavel yamma – techelta devavel. shuneya veguveya – techelta dachavel yamma. ravina amar: af tzitzora. tanya name hachi, chanan ben pinchas omer: chavel yamma – techelta devavel, shuneya veguveya vetzitzora – techelta dachavel yamma. amar rav pappa: vehaiddana iaravi behu kutae. vela hi, itteta hu diva minnayyhu, vela yehavu leh. may chavel yamma? amar rav pappa: zo perat devorsi.

Hahu gavra daamar lehu: ana min shot meshot, amad rabbi yitzchak nappacha al raglav veamar: shot meshot ben hanneharot omedet. vechi ben hanneharot omedet, may have? amar abbaye, amar rabbi chama bar ukeva, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: ben hanneharot hare hi kaggola leyuchasin. vehecha kayyma? amar rabbi yochanan: meihi dekira uleel. veha amar rabbi yochanan: ad mabarta degizma! amar abbaye: retzua nafka.

Amar rav ika bar avin amar rav chananel amar rav: chillazon nihavavnd hare hi kaggola leyuchasin. amar lehu abbaye: la tetzitu leh, yevama hi dinfala leh hatam. amar leh: attu didi hi? derav chananel hi! azul shayylu lerav chananel, amar lehu: hachi amar rav: chillazon nihavavnd hare hi kaggola leyuchasin.

Ufeliga derabbi abba bar kahana. deamar rabbi abba bar kahana: may dichtiv: "vayyanchem bachlach uvechavor nehar gozan veare maday", chalach – zo chillazon, chavor – zo hadeyayv, nehar gozan – zo ginzak, are maday – zo chamadan vechavroteha, veamri la: zo nihavavnd vechavroteha.

May chavroteha? amar shemuel: kerach musheke chuseke verumeke. amar rabbi yochanan: vechullam lifsul. kasalka data: musheke hayeynu mushekne. vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: mushekne hare hi kaggola leyuchasin! ella musheke lechud umushekne lechud.
"Utelat ilin befumma ben shinna". amar rabbi yochanan: zo chillazon, hadeyayv, unetzivin, sheppeamim bolatan ufeamim polattan.

"Vaaru cheva ochori tinyana damya ledov". tane rav yosef: ellu parsiyyim, sheochlin veshotin kedov, umesurebalin kedov, umegaddelin sear kedov, veen lahem menucha kedov. rabbi amme ki hava chaze parsa derachev, amar: hayeynu dubba nayyda.

Amar leh rabbi lelevi: hareeni parsiyyim. amar leh: domim lachayaylot shel bet david. hareeni chabbarin. domin lemalache chabbala. hareeni yishmeelim. domin lisirim shel bet hakkisse. hareeni talmide chachamim shebbevavel. domim lemalache hashsharet.

Ki hava nicha nafsheh derabbi amar: humanya ikka bevavel – kulla ammonae hi. masgarya ikka bevavel – kullah demamzere hi. birka ikka bevavel – shene achim yesh [bah] shemmachalifim neshotehem ze laze. birta desatya ikka bevavel – hayyom saru meachare hammakom, deakpi pira bichvore beshabbeta vaazuyl vetzadu behu beshabbeta veshammetinhu rabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya veishtammud. akra deagma ikka bevavel – adda bar ahava yesh bah,
b: Hayyom yoshev becheko shel avraham. hayyom nolad rav yehuda bevavel.

Deamar mar: keshemmet rabbi akiva nolad rabbi. keshemmet rabbi nolad rav yehuda. keshemmet rav yehuda nolad rava. keshemmet rava nolad rav ashe. lelammedcha sheen tzaddik niftar min haolam ad shennivra tzaddik kemoto, shenneemar: "vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh". ad shello kavta shimsho shel eli zarcha shimsho shel shemuel haramati, shenneemar: "vener elohim terem yichbe ushemuel shochev vegomer".
"Tzivva Adonai leyaakov sevivav tzarav". rav yehuda amar: kegon humanya lefum nahara.

"Vayhi kehinnavi ufelatyahu ven benaya met vaeppol al panay vaezak kol gadol vaomar ahah adonay Adonai", rav ushemuel: chad amar: letova, vechad amar: leraa. man deamar letova – ki ha deistandera demeshan chatneh dinvuchadnetztzar hava, shelach leh: mikkulle hay sheviyyay deayytet lach – la shaddart lan dekae lekamman?
Bae leshaddore leh miyyisrael. amar leh pelatyahu ben benayahu: anan dachashivinan neku mikkammach hacha, veavdin nezlu lehatam. vaamar neviyya: mi sheasa tova beyisrael, yamut bachatzi yamav?

Man deamar leraa, dichtiv: "vattave oti el shaar bet Adonai hakkadmoni happone kadima vehinne befetach hashshaar esrim vachamishsha ish vaere vetocham et yaazanya ven azzur veet pelatyahu ven benayahu sare haam", uchetiv: "vayyavo oti el chatzar bet Adonai happenimit vehinne fetach hechal Adonai ben haulam uven hammizbeach keesrim vachamishsha ish achorehem el hechal Adonai ufenehem kedma".

Mimmashma shenneemar: "ufenehem kedma" eni yodea sheachorehem kelappe maarav? ma talmud lomar "[achorehem] el hechal Adonai" – melammed shehayu mafriin atzmam umatrizin atzmam kelappe mala. vekaamar neviyya: mi sheasa haraa hazzot beyisrael yamut al mittato?!

Tistayyem dishmuel deamar leraa, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: mushekne – hare hi kaggola layyochasim. meshon – lo chashu lah lo mishshum avdut velo mishshum mamzerut, ella kohanim shehayu bah lo hikpidu al haggerushot.

Leolam ema lach shemuel amar letova, ushemuel letameh deamar: hammafkir avdo – yatza lecherut veeno tzarich get shichrur, shenneemar: "kol eved ish miknat kasef", eved ish velo eved ishsha? ella: eved sheyyesh lo reshut lerabbo alav – karuy eved, eved sheen lerabbo reshut alav – en karuy eved.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: kol aratzot bechezkat kesherot hem omdot.

Ammemar shera leh lerav huna bar natan leminsav itteta mechuzeyayta. amar leh rav ashe: may dataych – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: kol aratzot bechezkat kesherot hen omdot? veha be rav kahana la matnu hachi, uve rav pappa la matnu hachi, uve rav zevid la matnu hachi! afillu hachi la kaybla minneh, mishshum dishmia leh merav zevid dinhardea.

Tanu rabbanan: mamzere unetine tehorim leatid lavo, divre rabbi yose. rabbi meir omer: en tehorim. amar lo rabbi yose: vahalo kevar neemar: "vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem"! amar lo rabbi meir: keshehu omer: "mikkol tumotechem umikkol gillulechem" – velo min hammamzerut. amar lo rabbi yose: keshehu omer: "ataher etchem" – heve omer af min hammamzerut.

Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "veyashav mamzer beashdod". ella lerabbi yose, may "veyashav mamzer beashdod"? kedimtargem rav yosef: yetvun bet yisrael leruchetzan bearahon dahavo (damu) [damayin] ba lenucherain.
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. amar rav yosef: i lav deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose, hava ate eliyyahu mappek minnan tzavvrane tzavvrane kolarin.

Tanu rabbanan: ger nose mamzeret, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: ger lo yissa mamzeret. echad ger echad eved meshucherar vechalal muttarim bechohenet. may tama derabbi yose? chamishsha kehale ketivi.

a: Chad – lechohanim, vechad – lalviyyim, vechad – leyisreelim, vechad – lemishre mamzer bishtuki, vechad – lemishre shetuki beyisrael. kehal gerim la ikkeri kahal. verabbi yehuda? kohanim uleviyyim mechad "kahal" nafki, iyyaytar leh likhal gerim.
Veibbaet ema: hachi name, tere kehale ninhu, mamzer bishtuki ushetuki beyisrael mechad "kahal" nafka – "lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai" –
Mamzer vadday hu delo yavo, ha mamzer safek – yavo, bekahal vadday hu delo yavo, ha bekahal safek – yavo.
Veibbaet ema: hane name tere kehale ninhu, vetameh derabbi yehuda mehacha: "hakkahal chukka achat lachem velagger haggar". ulerabbi yose? "chukka achat" – hifsik hainyan.
Echad ger veechad eved meshucherar vechalal muttarin bechohenet. mesayyeya leh lerav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo huzeharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulim.

Derash rabbi zera bemachoza: ger muttar bemamzeret. ragmu kulle alma beetrogayyhu. amar rava: mi ikka dedaresh milleta ki hay beducheta dishchichi giyyore? derash rava bemachoza: ger muttar bechohenet. taanu beshirae. hadar derash lehu: ger muttar bemamzeret. amaru leh: afsedta lekammayyta. amar lehu: detava lechu avadi lechu, i bae mehacha nasev vei bae mehacha nasev.
Vehilcheta: ger muttar bechohenet umuttar bemamzeret. muttar bechohenet – lo huzeharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulim, umuttar bemamzeret – kerabbi yose.
Ellu hen: shetuki – kol shemmakkir. amar rava: devar tora shetuki kasher. may tama – rov kesherim etzlah, umiut pesulin etzlah.
Vei azli inhu legabba, kol defaresh – merubba paresh. may amrat – dilma azla ihi legabbayyhu hava leh kavua, vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame,
Vehattora amra: "lo yavo mamzer" – mamzer vadday hu delo yavo, ha mamzer safek – yavo. bekahal vadday hu delo yavo, ha bekahal safek – yavo!
Uma taam amru shetuki pasul? gezera shemma yissa achoto meaviv. ella meatta, shetuki – shetukit lo yissa, shemma yissa achoto meaviv!
Kol ki hane mezannu veazli? bat shetukit lo yissa, shemma yissa achoto meaviv! ella: la shechicha, hachi name la shechicha!
Ella maala asu beyuchasin.
Veamar rava, devar tora: asufi – kasher. may tama? eshet ish – bevalah tola. may ikka? miut arusot umiut shehalach baalehem limdinat hayyam,

Kevan deikka penuya, veikka name demechamat reavon, have palga ufalga. vehattora amra: "lo yavo mamzer bekahal Adonai" – mamzer vadday hu delo yavo, ha mamzer safek yavo. bekahal vadday hu delo yavo, ha bekahal safek yavo.

Uma taam amru asufi pasul – shemma yissa achoto meaviv. ella meatta asufi – asufit lo yissa, shemma yissa achoto ben meaviv ben meimmo! kol hane shadu veazli?! bat asufi lo yissa, shemma yissa achoto! ella la shechiach, hachi name la shechiach.
Ella, maala asu beyochasim.
Amar rava bar rav huna: metzao mahul –
b: En bo mishshum asufi. meshalleti haddameh – en bo mishshum asufi. shayif mishcha, umele kuchela, reme chumere, tele pitka, utele kemia – en bo mishshum asufi.
Tele bedikle, i matya leh chayya – yesh bo mishshum asufi, im lav – en bo mishshum asufi.
Zardeta semicha lemata – yesh bo mishshum asufi, veim lav – en bo mishshum asufi. be chenishta semichta lemata ushechichi beh rabbim – en bo mishshum asufi, veim lav – yesh bo mishshum asufi.

Amar ammemar: hay pera desufele – yesh bo mishshum asufi, charifta denahara – en bo mishshum asufi. pishre – yesh bo mishshum asufi. tzidde reshut harabbim – en bo mishshum asufi. reshut harabbim – yesh bo mishshum asufi.

Amar rava: uvishne reavon en bo mishshum asufi. ha derava aheyay? illema arshut harabbim – ayyeyde dishne reavon katla leh?! veella atztzidde reshut harabbim – may irya shene reavon? afillu bela shene reavon!
Ella ki ittemar derava – aha deamar rav yehuda amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yehuda bar zavdi amar rav: kol zeman shebbashshuk – aviv veimmo neemanim alav, neesaf min hashshuk – en neemanim alav.
May tama? amar rava: hoil veyatza alav shem asufi. veamar rava: uvishne reavon, af al pi shenneesaf min hashshuk aviv veimmo neemanim alav.
Amar rav chisda: shelosha neemanim lealtar, ellu hen: asufi, chayya, ufoteret chavroteha.
Asufi – ha daamaran.

Chayya – detanya: chayya neemenet lomar ze yatza rishon veze yatza sheni. bamme devarim amurim – shello yatzta vechazra, aval yatzta vechazra – enah neemenet. rabbi eliezer omer: huchezka al omdah – neemenet, veim lav – enah neemenet. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deahdar appa.

Poteret chavroteha may hi? ditnan: shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen – kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet temea – hi temea, vechullan tehorot. amar rav chisda: shebbadka atzmah keshiur vevset.
Tanu rabbanan: neemenet chayya lomar: ze kohen veze levi, ze natin veze mamzer. bamme devarim amurim – shello kara aleha shem arar, aval kara aleha arar – enah neemenet.
Arar demay? illema arar chad, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: en arar pachot mishshenayim! ella arar tere.
Veibbaet ema: leolam ema lach arar chad. vechi amar rabbi yochanan en arar pachot mishshenayim – hane mille hecha deita chazaka dechashrut, aval hecha delekka chazaka dechashrut – chad name meheman.
Neeman baal mikkach lomar: laze macharti, velaze en macharti. bamme devarim amurim – bizman shemmikkacho beyado, aval en mikkacho beyado – eno neeman.

a: Venichze zuze mimman naket? la tzericha denaket mittarvayyhu veamar: chad middatay, vechad beal kurechay. vela yedia he middato vehe lo middato.
Neeman dayyayn lomar: laze zikkiti velaze chiyyayvti. bamme devarim amurim – shebbaale dinim omdim lefanav, aval en baale dinim omdim lefanav – eno neeman. venichze zechuta man naket?
La tzericha, dikria zechutayyhu. venihdar venidayyeyninhu! beshuda dedayyayne.
Amar rav nachman: shelosha neemanin al habbechor, ellu hen: chayya, aviv, veimmo. chayya – lealtar, immo – kol shiva, aviv – leolam. kidtanya. "yakkir" – yakkirennu laacherim.
Mikkan amar rabbi yehuda: neeman adam lomar: "ze beni bechor". ucheshem shenneeman lomar: "ze beni bechor", kach neeman lomar: "ze ben gerusha" veze ben chalutza". vachachamim omrim: eno neeman.

Abba shaul haya kore lashshetuki "beduki". may "beduki"? ilema shebbodkin et immo veomeret: lechasher nivalti – neemenet, keman – kerabban gamliel, tenena chada zimna! ditnan: hayta meubberet, veamru lah: ma tivo shel ubbar ze? amra lahem: meish peloni vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin. veamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel.
– Chada lehacheshir bah, vachada lehacheshir bevittah. hanicha leman deamar: ledivre hammachshir bah – posel bevittah.
Ella leman deamar: ledivre hammachshir bah – machshir bevittah, abba shaul may ata leashmoinan?
Deabba shaul adifa midderabban gamliel. dei mehatam hava amena: hatam, derov kesherin etzlah, aval hecha derov pesulin etzlah – ema la, tzericha. amar rava: halacha keabba shaul.
Mishna kol haasurin lavo bakkahal – muttarim lavo ze baze. rabbi yehuda oser.
Rabbi eliezer omer: vaddaan bevaddaan – muttar, vaddaan bisfekan, usefekan bevaddaan, usefekan bisfekan – asur. veellu hen hassefekot: shetuki, asufi, vechuti.
Gemara may kol haasurin lavo bakkahal? ilema mamzere unetine shetuke vaasufe – ha tena leh resha, mamzere unetine shetuke vaasufe muttarim lavo ze baze!

Vetu: rabbi yehuda oser, aheyay? illema avvaddaan bisfekan – ha middekatane sefa rabbi eliezer omer: vaddaan bevaddaan – muttar, vaddaan bisfekan, usefekan bisfekan – asur, mikkelal derabbi yehuda la sevira leh!
Vechi tema: rabbi yehuda oser agger bemamzeret, midde ger bemamzeret katane? kol haasurin lavo bakkahal katane!
Amar rav yehuda:
b: Hachi kaamar: kol haasurim lavo bikhal kehunna, may ninhu – giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, udela kerabbi shimon ben yochay – muttarin lavo ze baze.
Venokma bevat shalosh shanim veyom echad, vaafillu lerabbi shimon ben yochay! im ken, mitztzidda tavra.

Ella tama devat shalosh shanim veyom echad, ha pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, demutteret lavo bikhal kehunna, asura lavo ze baze? hare pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad lerabbi shimon ben yochay, demutteret lavo bikhal kehunna umuvteret lavo ze baze!

Uchelala hu dechol haasurim lavo bikhal kehunna muttarin lavo ze baze? vahare almana ugerusha vachalala vezona daasurim lavo bikhal kehunna, vaasurim lavo ze baze! vetu: ha muttar asur? vahare ger shemmuttar bechohenet umuttar bemamzeret!
Ella amar rav natan bar hoshaya: hachi kaamar: kol shekkohen asur lissa et bitto, umay nihu – ger shennasa giyyoret. ucherabbi eliezer ben yaakov – muttarin lavo ze baze.
Uchelala hu dechol shekkohen asur lissa et bitto muttarim lavo ze baze? hare chalal shennasa bat yisrael, dechohen asur lissa bitto, vaasurin name lavo ze baze! la kashya, kerabbi dostay ben yehuda.
Vahare chalal shennasa chalala vechohen asur lissa bitto, veasur name lavo ze baze! vetu: ha muttar asur? vahare ger shennasa bat yisrael, vechohen muttar lissa bitto, umuttarin lavo ze baze!
Ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hacha mamzer meachoto umamzer meeshet ish ikka benayyhu.
Tanna kamma savar: afillu mamzer meachoto name have mamzer. verabbi yehuda savar: meeshet ish have mamzer, meachoto – la have mamzer.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: ezehu mamzer – kol shehu belo yavo", divre rabbi akiva.
Shimon hattimni omer: kol shechayyayvin alav karet bide shamayim, vahalacha kidvarav. rabbi yehoshua omer: kol shechayyayvin alav mitat bet din.
Ella amar rava: ger ammoni umoavi ikka benayyhu, vehachi kaamar: kol haasurim lavo bakkahal, umay nihu: ger ammoni umoavi – muttarin lavo ze baze.
I hachi may rabbi yehuda oser? hachi kaamar: af al pi sherabbi yehuda oser ger bemamzeret, hane mille ger derauy lavo bakkahal, aval ger ammoni umoavi deen reuyin lavo bakkahal – la.

Tanu rabbanan: ben tesha shanim veyom echad ger ammoni umoavi, mitzri vaadomi, kuti venatin, chalal umamzer shebbau al hakkohenet veal haleviyya veal bat yisrael – [pesaluha]. rabbi yose omer: kol shezzaro pasul – posel, vechol sheen zaro pasul – eno posel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer:

a: Kol sheatta nose bitto – atta nose almenato. vechol shei atta nose bitto – i atta nose almenato.
May ikka ben tanna kamma uven rabbi yose? amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni ikka benayyhu. ushenehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana,
Detanna kamma savar: ki kohen gadol bealmana. ma kohen gadol bealmana shebbiato baavera ufosel bah, af kol shebbiato baavera – posel.

Verabbi yose savar: ki chohen gadol bealmana. ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul ufosel, af kol shezzaro pasul – posel. leappoke mitzri sheni sheen zaro pasul, deamar kera: "banim asher yivvaldu lahem dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai".

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheatta nose bitto – atta nose almenato, vechol shei atta nose et bitto – i atta nose almenato. may ikka ben rabbi yose lerabban shimon ben gamliel? amar ulla: ger ammoni umoavi ikka benayyhu. ushenehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana.
Derabbi yose savar: ki kohen gadol bealmana. ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul – ufosel, af kol shezzaro pasul – posel.

Verabban shimon ben gamliel: kechohen gadol bealmana. ma kohen gadol bealmana shekkol zaro pasul, af kol shekkol zaro pasul, afillu nekevot, leappoke ger ammoni umoavi dinkevot havu kesherot lavo bakkahal. deamar mar: ammoni velo ammonit, moavi velo moavit.

Amar rav chisda: hakkol modim bealmenat issa sheppesula lakkehunna. man mekel behane tannae – rabban shimon ben gamliel, vekaamar: kol sheatta nose bitto – atta nose almenato, vechol shei atta nose bitto – i atta nose almenato. lemaote may? lemaote almenat issa sheppesula lakkehunna.
Leappoke middehane tannae ditnan: heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ben betera al almenat issa shekkeshera lakkehunna. may tama – have sefek sefeka, usefek sefeka lekulla.

Vaddaan bevaddaan muttar. amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi eliezer. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel amar li: hillel shone: asara yuchasim alu mibbavel vechullam muttarim lavo ze baze, veat amrat halacha kerabbi eliezer?!
Uremi derav adderav uremi dishmuel addishmuel, deittemar: arusa sheibbera, rav amar: havvalad mamzer. ushemuel amar: havvalad shetuki.
Rav amar: havvalad mamzer umuttar bemamzeret, ushemuel amar: havvalad shetuki veasur bemamzeret. efoch, rav amar: havvalad shetuki, ushemuel amar: havvalad mamzer.
Tarte lema li? tzericha, dei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rav mishshum derov kesherim etzlah. aval hatam, derov pesulim etzlah, ema mode lishmuel.
Vei ittemar behach, beha kaamar rav – mishshum deikka lemitl[ya] bearus, aval beha ema mode lishmuel, tzericha.

Vei baet ema: leolam la tefoch, umay mamzer dekaamar rav – lav muttar bemamzeret, ella deasur bevat yisrael. ushemuel amar: havvalad shetuki, deasur bevat yisrael. i hachi hayeynu derav! ella: may shetuki – shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna.
Peshita, hasheta middin yisrael meshattekinan leh, middin kehunna mibbee?! ella: may shetuki – shemmeshattekin oto minnichse aviv. peshita, mi yadinan avu mannu? la tzericha, ditfas.

Vei baet ema: may shetuki – beduki, shebbodkim et immo veomeret: "lechasher nivalti" – neemenet. keman – kerabban gamliel? haamar shemuel chada zimna, ditnan: hayta meubberet, veamru lah: ma tivo shel ubbar ze? meish peloni vechohen hu – rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer: enah neemenet. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel!
Tzericha, dei mehatam hava amena: hatam rov kesherim etzlah, aval hacha derov pesulim etzlah, ema la, tzericha.
Tanya: vechen rabbi elazar omer: kuti lo yissa kutit. may tama? amar rav yosef: asauhu keger leachar asara dorot, detanya: ger, ad asara dorot – muttar bemamzeret, mikkan veelach – asur bemamzeret.
Veyesh omrim ad sheyyishtakkea shem avoda zara mimmennu.

Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam ger yashan umamzeret chadasha, amri: bar yisrael hu deka nasev mamzeret. hacha idde veidde ki hadade ninhu. ella: ki ata rav dimi, amar: rabbi elazar savar la kerabbi yishmael,
b: Verabbi yishmael savar la kerabbi akiva. rabbi elazar savar la kerabbi yishmael, deamar: kutim gere arayot hem. verabbi yishmael savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael – havvalad mamzer.

Umi savar lah rabbi yishmael kerabbi akiva? vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: minnayin lenochri veeved shebbau al hakkohenet veal haleviyya veal bat yisrael sheppesaluha? shenneemar: "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah"
– Mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin, yatza nochri veeved sheen lo almenut vegerushin.
Vei salka datach savar la kerabbi akiva, hasheta mamzer have, mifsal beviato mibbaya?!
Ella, rabbi elazar savar la kerabbi yishmael, deamar: kutim gere arayot. vesavar la kerabbi akiva deamar: nochri veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad mamzer.
Umi savar la rabbi elazar kerabbi akiva? vehaamar rabbi elazar: af al pi shennechleku bet shammay uvet hillel betzarot modim sheen mamzer ella mimmi sheissuro issur erva veanush karet!

Ella, ki ata ravin amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rabbi chanina, veamri lah amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shalosh machlokot baddavar.

Rabbi yishmael savar: kutim gere arayot hen, vechohanim shennitmeu bahem – kohanim pesulim hayu, shenneemar: "veyaasu lahem miktzotam kohane vamot", veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: min hakkotzim shebbaam. umishshum hachi paslinhu.

Verabbi akiva savar: kutim gere emet hen, vechohanim shennitmeu bahen – kohanim kesherim hayu, shenneemar: "veyaasu lahem miktzotam kohane vamot", veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: min habbechirim shebbaam. veella mippene ma asarum – mippene shehayu meyaybmim et haarusot

a: Ufotrim et hannesuot. may darshi? "lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar" – hach deyatva chutza, hi lo tihye leish zar, aval hach dela yatva chutza – tihye leish zar.
Verabbi akiva letameh deamar: yesh mamzer mechayyayve lavin.

Veyesh omrim: lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzvot. man yesh omrim? amar rav idi bar avin: rabbi eliezer hi. detanya: matztzat kuti mutteret veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach, verabbi eliezer oser, lefi sheen bekiim bedikduke mitzvot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim – harebe medakdekim bah, yoter miyyisrael.
Veella hachi, may en bekiin? lefi sheen bekiin betorat kiddushin vegerushin.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: mamzer meachoto umamzer meeshet ach nitarvu bahen. may ka mashma lan, yesh mamzer mechayyayve charetot? nitne chada! maase shehaya kach haya.
Verava amar: eved veshifcha nitarvu bahen. issura mishshum may, mishshum shifcha? nitne chada! maase shehaya kach haya.

Mishna hannose ishsha kohenet – tzarich livdok achareha arba immahot shehen shemone: immah, veem immah, veem avi immah, veimmah, veem aviha veimmah, veem avi aviha veimmah. leviyya veyisreelit mosifin alehen od achat.

En bodkin lo min hammizbeach ulemala, velo min hadduchan ulemala, velo min hassanhedrin ulemala. vechol shehuchezku avotav mishshotre harabbim vegabbae tzedaka – massiin lakkehunna veen tzarich livdok acharehen.
Rabbi yose omer: af mi shehaya chatum ed bearche hayyeshana shel tzippori. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: af mi shehaya muchetav beisteratya shel melech.

Gemara may shena binshe badkinan umay shena begavre dela badkinan? neshe dechi minnetzu bahade hadade – baarayot hu deminnetzu, veim ita deikka milleta – la it lay kala, gavre dechi minnetzu bahade hadade – beyuchasin hu deminnetze, im ita deikka milleta – it lay kala.
Veihi name tivdok beh bedideh? mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo huzeharu kesherot linnase lifsulim.
Rav adda bar ahava tane: arba immahot shehem shetem esre. bematnita tana: arba immahot shehem shesh esre. bishlama lerav adda bar ahava –
b: Mokem la bilviyya uvat yisrael. ella matnita nema peliga? la, may "od achat" – zug achat.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: kol mishpachot bechezkat kesherot hen omdot. ini? vehaamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: mishnatenu keshekkore alav arar! man dematne ha – la matne ha.

Ikka deamri amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: kol mishpechot bechezkat kesherot hen omdot. amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: im kore alav arar, tzarich livdok achareha.
En bodkin min hammizbeach ulemala. may tama? i lav devadku la havo masseki leh. velo min hadduchan ulemala. may tama? deamar mar: sheshsham hayu yoshvim meyaychase kehunna umeyaychase leviyya.
Velo missanhedrin ulemala. may tama? detane rav yosef: keshem shebbet din menukkin betzedek – kach menukkin mikkol mum. amar marimar: may keraa – "kullach yafa rayati umum en bach".
Ema muma mammash! amar rav acha bar yaakov: amar kera: "vehityatztzevu sham immach", "immach" – bedomim lach.
Vedilma mishshum shechina? amar rav nachman, amar kera: "vehakel mealecha venasu ittach" – bedomim lach.

Kol mi shehuchezku avotav mishshotre harabbim. lememra dela mokminan mippesulim? ureminhu: hakkol kesherim ladun dine mamonot, veen hakkol kesherim ladun dine nefashot. vehavenan bah: "hakkol" leetoye may? veamar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer! amar abbaye: birushalayim. vechen tane rav shimon bar zera bekiddushe deve levi: birushalayim.
Vegabbae tzedaka massiim. may tama? kevan deminnetzu bahade inashe, deamar mar: memashkenim al hatztzedaka vaafillu beerev shabbat, veim ita deikka – it leh kala.

Ushepizkaneh derav adda bar ahava giyyora hava, vahava ka minnetze ihu verav bivi, mar amar: ana avedna seraruta demata, umar amar: ana avedna seraruta demata. ato lekammeh derav yosef amar lehu: tenena: "som tasim alecha melech... mikkerev achecha", kol mesimot sheatta mesim – lo yihye ella mikkerev achecha.

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava: vaafillu immo miyyisrael? amar leh: immo miyyisrael mikkerev achecha karena beh. hilkach rav bivi degavra rabba hu – liayyen bemille dishmayya, umar – liayyen bemille demata. amar abbaye hilkach man demashre tzureba midderabbanan beushepizkaneh – lashre kerav adda bar ahava, (deyada limhappech) [dimhappech] leh bizchuteh.
Rabbi zera mittappal behu, rabba bar avu mittappal behu. bemareva afillu resh kore la mokmi minnayyhu. binhardea afillu resh garguta la mokmi minnayyhu.
Rabbi yose omer: af mi shehaya vechulei. may tama? dayyki umachtemi.

Rabbi chanina ben antignos vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bachayaylot shel bet david. amar rav yosef: may kera? "vehityachsam batztzava bammilchama". vetama may? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kede shettehe zechutan uzechut avotam mesayyaytan.
Vehaikka tzelek haammoni, may lav deate meammon? la, deyatev beammon. vehaikka uriyya hachitti, may lav deate mechet? la, deyatev bechet.
Vehaikka ittay haggitti! vechi tema hachi name deyatev begat, veha amar rav nachman: ittay haggitti ba uvittelah!

Veod amar rav yehuda amar rav: arba meot yeladim hayu lo ledavid, vechullam bene yefat toar hayu, vechullam mistapperim kome, umegaddelim belorit hayu, vechullam yoshvim bikroniyyot shel zahav vehayu mehallechim berashe geyaysot, vehen hen baale egrofim shel bet david! deazli levaote alma.

a: Mishna bat chalal zachar – pesula min hakkehunna leolam. yisrael shennasa chalala – bitto keshera lakkehunna. chalal shennasa bat yisrael – bitto pesula lakkehunna. rabbi yehuda omer: bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yisrael shennasa giyyoret – bitto keshera lakkehunna, veger shennasa bat yisrael – bitto keshera lakkehunna, aval ger shennasa giyyoret – bitto pesula lakkehunna. echad ger veechad avadim meshucherarim afillu ad asara dorot, ad shettehe immo miyyisrael. rabbi yose omer: af ger shennasa giyyoret bitto keshera lakkehunna.
Gemara may leolam? mahu detema: midde dahava ammitzri vaadomi, ma lehallan leachar shelosha dorot, af kan name leachar shelosha dorot, ka mashma lan.

Yisrael shennasa chalala. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon: neemar kan: "velo yechallel zaro beammav", veneemar lehallan: "lo yittamma baal beammav". ma lehallan zecharim velo nekevot, af kan zecharim velo nekevot.
Ella meatta, bitto shel kohen gadol tishtere! mi ketiv beno? "zaro" ketiv, "lo yechallel zaro beammav".
Bat beno tishtere! ketiv "lo yechallel zaro", makkish zaro lo, ma hu – bitto pesula, af beno – bitto pesula. bat bitto tittesar! im ken, gezera shava may ahani leh?

Chalal shennasa bat yisrael – bitto pesula. ha tena leh resha: "bat chalal zachar pesula min hakkehunna leolam"! ayyeyde ditna resha yisrael shennasa chalala, tena name sefa chalal shennasa bat yisrael.

Matnitin dela kerabbi dostay ben yehuda, detanya: rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer: keshem shebbene yisrael mikve tohora lachalalot, kach benot yisrael mikve tohora lachalalim. may tameh derabbi dostay berabbi yehuda? amar kera: "lo yechallel zaro beammav" – beim echad hu demechel, bishne amamim eno mechel.
Tanu rabbanan: "lo yechallel zaro" – en li ella zaro, hi atzmah, minnayin? amarta: kal vachomer, ma zaro shello avar avera – mitchallel, hi sheavra avera – eno din shemmitchallelet?
Hu, atzmo yochiach, sheavar avera veen mitchallel! ma lehu, shekken en mitchallel bechol makom, tomar behi, shemmitchallelet bechol makom.
Veim nafshecha lomar: amar kera "lo yechallel zaro" – lo yechullal, ze shehaya kasher venitchallel.
May "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema ikka lemifrach: ma lezaro – shekken yetzirato baavera, amar kera: "lo yechallel", lo yecholel – ze shehaya kasher venitchallel.
Tanu rabbanan: ezo hi chalala – kol shennolda min happesulim. may "pesulim"? ilema pesulim lo, hare machazir gerushato difsula lo uvaneha kesherim, dichtiv "toeva hi" – hi toeva, veen baneha toavim!
Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar: ezo hi chalala – kol shennolda min pesul kehunna. nolda – in, lo nolda – la? hare almana, ugerusha, zona, delo nolda, veka havya chalala!

Amar rabba: hachi kaamar: ezo chalala muzekeret shello haya lah sheat hakkosher kelal? kol shennolda min pesul kehunna. may "muzekeret"? amar rav yitzchak bar avin: hachi kaamar: ezo hi chalala sheikkarah middivre tora veen tzerichin lefaresh middivre sofrim – kol shennolda min pesule kehunna.
Tanu rabbanan: almana almana almana – eno chayyayv ella achat. gerusha gerusha gerusha – eno chayyayv ella achat.
Almana ugerusha vachalala zona, bizman shehem kasseder – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. zinneta venitchallela venitgarsha venitarmela – eno chayyayv ella achat.
Amar mar: almana almana almana – eno chayyayv ella achat. hay almana hechi dame? illema shebba al almenat reuven veal almenat shimon veal almenat levi, ammay eno chayyayv ella achat?
b: Hare gufin muchelakim, hare shemot muchelakim!
Ella shebba al almana achat shalosh biot. hechi dame? i dela atro beh – peshita deeno chayyayv ella achat.

Ella deatro beh akkol chada vachada – ammay eno chayyayv ella achat? vehatnan: nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom kullo – eno chayyayv ella achat. amru lo: "al tishte" "al tishte" vehu shote – chayyayv al kol achat veachat!
La tzericha, shebba al almenat reuven shehayta almenat shimon shehayta almenat levi. mahu detema hare shemot muchelakim – ka mashma lan gufim muchelakim baenan, velekka.
"Almana ugerusha vachalala zona". hay tanna may kasavar? i kasavar issur chal al issur – ippecha name! vei kasavar en issur chal al issur – afillu kasseder hazze name la!
Amar rava: hay tanna issur chal al issur let leh, issur mosif it leh.

Almana asura lechohen gadol vesharya lechohen hedyot. havya la gerusha, miggo deittosaf la issura legabbe kohen hedyot – ittosaf la issura legabbe kohen gadol, vaadayin sharya lemechal bitruma. havya la chalala, miggo deittosaf issura lemechal bitruma – ittosaf issura legabbe kohen gadol.
Ella zona – may issur mosif it ba? amar rav chana bar rav kattina: hoil veshem zenut posel beyisrael.
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: kol shehu beyikkach", hare hu belo yikkach". kol sheeno beyikkach" eno belo yikkach" – perat lechohen gadol shebba al achoto almana.
Amar leh: daamar lach, manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: en issur chal al issur. detanya: rabbi shimon omer: haochel nevela beyom hakkippurim – patur. dei rabbanan, ha amri: issur chal al issur.
Afillu tema rabbanan, ki amri rabbanan issur chal al issur – hane mille issur chamur al issur kal, aval issur kal al issur chamur – la chayel.

Ikka deamri: ha manni – rabbanan hi, deamri: issur chal al issur, vechi amri rabbanan issur chal al issur, hane mille issur chamur al issur kal, aval issur kal al issur chamur – la chayel. dei rabbi shimon, hasheta issur chamur al issur kal la chayel, issur kal al issur chamur mibbaya?
Mahu detema: issur kehunna shane, ka mashma lan.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: yisrael habba al achoto – zona meshavve la. chalala, meshavve la o la meshavve la?
Mi amrinan kal vachomer: mechayyayve lavin havya chalala, mechayyayve charetot lo kol shekken? o dilma en chalala ella meissur kehunna? amar leh: en (issur) chalala ella meissur kehunna bilvad.

Amar rava: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan "en chalala ella meissur kehunna"? detanya: lo yeamer gerusha bechohen gadol vetete bekal vachomer mikkohen hedyot, vaana amena: hasheta lechohen hedyot asura, lechohen gadol mibbaya? lamma neemra: keshem shechaluka gerusha mizzona vachalala bechohen hedyot, kach chaluka bechohen gadol.
Peshita, migra gara? ella: keshem shechaluka gerusha mizzona vachalala bechohen hedyot – kach almana chaluka miggerusha vachalala zona bechohen gadol.
Chalala lamma neemra? en chalala ella meissur kehunna. zona lamma neemra? neemar kan "zona", veneemar lehallan "zona", ma kan zaro chullin, af lehallan zaro chullin.
Amar rav ashe: hilkach, kohen habba al achoto

a: – Zona meshavve la, chalala la meshavve la. chazar uva aleha – asaah chalala.
Amar rav yehuda: kohen gadol bealmana loke shetayim, achat mishshum "lo yikkach", veachat mishshum "lo yechallel". velilke name mishshum "lo yechallel zaro"! beshello gamar biato.
Metiv rava: almana ugerusha loke mishshum shene shemot, may lav shene shemot vetu la?
La, shene shemot al ze ushene shemot al ze.
I hachi ema sefa: gerusha vachalutza – eno chayyayv ella al achat! hachi kaamar: eno chayyayv ella al achat, uleolam shene shemot.
Vachalutza derabbanan? vehatanya: gerusha – en li ella gerusha, chalutza minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha"! midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
