Amar abbaye: kiddesh – loke, baal – loke. kiddesh loke mishshum "lo yikkach". baal loke mishshum "lo yechallel". rava amar: baal – loke, lo baal – eno loke, mishshum dichtiv: "lo yikkach... velo yechallel" ma taam "lo yikkach"? mishshum "lo yechallel".
Umode abbaye bemachazir gerushato, sheim kiddesh velo baal – sheeno loke. "lekachtah lihyot lo leishsha" amar rachamana, veha lekka.

Umode rava bechohen gadol bealmana, sheim baal velo kiddesh – shelloke. "velo yechallel zaro beammav" amar rachamana, vahare hu chillel. ushenehem modim bemachzir gerushato, sheim baal velo kiddesh – sheeno loke, derech likkuchin asra tora.

Rabbi yehuda omer: bat ger zachar kevat chalal. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar. vehaddin noten: ma chalal, shebba mittippa keshera – bitto pesula, ger, shebba mittippa pesula – eno din shebbitto pesula?
Ma lechalal, shekken yetzirato baavera. kohen gadol bealmana yochiach, sheen yetzirato baavera, bitto pesula.
Ma lechohen gadol bealmana, shekken biato baavera! chalal yochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheenan berov hakkahal, af ani avi et hagger sheeno berov hakkahal uvitto pesula.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahem tzad avera!
La tema kohen gadol bealmana yochiach, ella ema: mitzri rishon yochiach.
Ma lemitzri rishon, shekken eno rauy lavo bakkahal. chalal yochiach.
Vechazar haddin. lo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheenan berov kahal, uvitto pesula. af ani avi et hagger, sheeno berov kahal uvitto pesula.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken poslim beviatam. verabbi yehuda: ger name posel beviato, umayyte la bamma hatztzad mehay dina.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer ger. tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad – keshera lakkehunna, shenneemar: "vechol hattaf bannashim... hachayu lachem", vahalo pinchas haya immahem! verabbanan? "hachayu lachem" – laavadim velishfachot.

Vechullan mikra echad darshu: "almana ugerusha lo yikchu lahem lenashim ki im betulot mizzera bet yisrael", rabbi yehuda savar: ad deit kol zera miyyisrael. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: "mizzera", vaafillu miktzat zera.
Rabbi yose savar: mi shennizreu beyisrael. rabbi shimon ben yochay savar: mi shennizreu betuleha beyisrael.
Amar leh rav nachman lerava:
b: Hay kera, resha bechohen gadol vesefa bechohen hedyot?! amar leh: in.

Uchetav kera hachi? amar leh: in, dichtiv: "vener elohim terem yichbe ushemuel shochev behechal Adonai" – vahalo en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche vet david bilvad! ella: "ner elohim terem yichbe" – behechal Adonai, "ushemuel shochev" – bimkomo.

"Vehaalmana asher tihye almana mikkohen yikkachu" – "mikkohen" – in, miyyisrael la?! hachi kaamar: "mikkohen yikkachu" – mishshear kohanim yikkachu. tanya name hachi: "mikkohen yikkachu" – mishshear kohanim yikkachu.

Rabbi yehuda omer: min hammassiim lakkehunna yikkachu. rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar, kol sheatta nose bitto – atta nose almenato, vechol shei atta nose bitto – i atta nose almenato.

Rabbi yose omer: af ger shennasa giyyoret. amar rav hamenuna mishshemeh deulla: halacha kerabbi yose. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana: halacha kerabbi yose. umiyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: ba limmalech – morim lo kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, nasa – en motziim otah mimmennu, kerabbi yose.
Mishna haomer "beni ze mamzer" – eno neeman. vaafillu shenehem modim al haubbar shebbemeeha mamzer hu – enam neemanim. rabbi yehuda omer: neemanim.

Gemara may "vaafillu shenehem"? la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya ihu, dela kim leh, ella afillu ihi dekim la – la mehemna. vela mibbaya hecha deit leh chazaka dechashrut, dela mehemni, ella afillu ubbar name, delet leh chazaka dechashrut la mehemni.

Rabbi yehuda omer neemanim. kidtanya: "yakkir" – yakkirennu laacherim. mikkan amar rabbi yehuda: neeman adam lomar: "ze beni bechor". ucheshem shenneeman adam lomar: "ze beni bechor", kach neeman adam lomar "ze ben gerusha" veze ben chalutza". vachachamim omrim: eno neeman.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: bishlama lerabbi yehuda – hayeynu dichtiv "yakkir", ella lerabbanan, "yakkir" lema li?
Bitzrich hekkera. lemay hilcheta? latet lo pi shenayim? peshita, lema li kera? miggo dei bae mitteva leh mattana, mi la yahavi leh?
Binchasim shennaflu leachar mikken.
Ulerabbi meir, deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam, "yakkir" lema li? shennaflu lo keshehu goses.
Mishna mi shennatan reshut lishlucho lekaddesh et bitto, vehalach hu vekiddeshah, im shello kadmu – kiddushav kiddushin, veim shel shelucho kadmu – kiddushav kiddushin, veim eno yadua

a: – Shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu – echad noten get, veechad kones.

Vechen haishsha shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah, vehalcha vekiddeshah et atzmah, im shellah kadmu – kiddusheha kiddushin, veim shel sheluchah kadmu – kiddushav kiddushin. veim enan yodin – shenehem notnim lah get, veim ratzu – echad noten lah get veechad kones.
Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe dideh, mishshum degavra kim leh beyuchasin, aval itteta dela kim la beyuchasin, ema la nihvo kiddusheha kiddushin.
Vei ashmeinan gabbe dida, mishshum deitteta dayyka uminnasva, aval ihu ema la ichpat leh, tzericha.
Ittemar: kiddeshah aviha badderech, vekiddesha atzmah bair, vahare hi bogeret. rav amar: hare hi bogeret lefanenu. ushemuel amar: chayyshinan lekiddushe shenehem.

Emat? illema betoch shishsha, beha nema rav hare hi bogeret lefanenu? hasheta hu devagra. ella leachar shishsha, beha nema shemuel: chayyshinan lekiddushe shenehem? veha amar shemuel: en ben nearot levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad!
La tzericha, dekaddesh behahu yoma demashlem shishsha. rav amar: hare hi bogeret lefanenu, middehashta bogeret, betzafra name bogeret. ushemuel amar: hasheta hu deayytay simanim.
Ushemuel, may shena mimmikve? ditnan: mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser – kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim – temeot.
Shane hatam, deikka lememar: haamed tame al chezkato veemar lo taval.
Adderabba, haamed mikve al chezkato veemar lo chasar! hare chaser lefanecha. hacha name: hare bogeret lefanecha! hasheta hu divgara. hatam name: hasheta hu dachasar!
Hatam tarte lereuta, hacha chada lereuta.
Ushemuel, may shena mechavit? detanya: haya bodek et hechavit lehaferish aleha teruma veholech, veachar kach nimtzet chometz – kol shelosha yamim vadday, mikkan veelach – safek.
Veramenan chavit ammikve: may shena dehacha vadday umay shena dehacha safek?
Veamar rav chanina missureya: man tena chavit – rabbi shimon hi, degabbe mikve name sefeka meshavve.
Detanya: kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim – temeot. verabbi shimon omer: birshut harabbim tehorot, birshut hayyachid – tolin.
Aval lerabbanan, tevel lemafrea! shane hatam, deikka lememar: haamed tevel al chezkato – veemar lo nitkan.
Adderabba, haamed yayin al chezkato, veemar lo hechmitz! hare hechmitz lefanecha. hacha name, hare hi bogeret lefanenu! hasheta hu divgara. hacha name: hasheta hu deachmetz!
Hatam tarte lereuta, hacha chada lereuta hu deikka.
Nema ketannae:
b: Mi motzi miyyad mi?

Hu motzi miyyadam belo reaya, vehen en motziim miyyado belo reaya, divre rabbi yaakov. rabbi natan omer: im bari hu – alav lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera, veim shechiv mera hu – alehem lehavi reaya shebbari haya.

Nema rav deamar kerabbi natan ushemuel deamar kerabbi yaakov? amar lach rav: ana daamari afillu kerabbi yaakov. ad kan la kaamar rabbi yaakov hatam deikka lememar haamed mamon al chezkato, aval hacha mi nema haamed guf al chezkato?!

Ushemuel amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbi natan. ad kan la kaamar rabbi natan hatam dechulle alma bechezkat beriim kayymi, man deka mappek nafsheh mechazaka – (have) aleh leetoye reaya, aval hacha mi ka mappeka nafsha mechazaka dekammeh?

Nema kehane tannae: kiddeshah aviha badderech vekiddesha atzmah bair vahare hi bogeret, tana chada: hare hi bogeret lefanenu, vetanya iddach: chayyshinan lekiddushe shenehem. may lav: chad kerav vechad kishmuel?
La, idi veidi kishmuel – kan bemachchashto, kan besheen machchashto.

Venema middematnita la peligi, amorae name la peligi! vetisbera? ha rav yosef bereh derav menashsheya middevivyl avad ovada kevoteh derav, veikkefid shemuel veamar: kulle alma kayyli leh bekabba zuta vehay midderabbanan kayyli leh bekabba rabba? vei salka datach la peligi, ammay ka mikkefed?
Dilma ki avad ovada, bemachchashto.
Amar leh mar zutera lerav ashe, hachi amar ammemar: hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel. verav ashe amar: hilcheta kevoteh derav. vehilcheta kevoteh derav.

Mishna mi sheyyatza hu veishto limdinat hayyam, uva hu veishto uvanav veamar: "ishsha sheyyatzat immi limdinat hayyam – hare hi zo, veellu baneha" – en tzarich lehavi reaya lo al haishsha, velo al habbanim. "meta veellu baneha" – mevi reaya al habbanim, veeno mevi reaya al haishsha.
"Ishsha nasati bimdinat hayyam – hare hi zo, veellu baneha" – mevi reaya al haishsha veen tzarich lehavi reaya al habbanim. "meta veellu baneha" – tzarich lehavi reaya al haishsha veal habbanim.
Gemara amar rabba bar rav huna: vechullan bichruchim achareha.

Tanu rabbanan: "ishsha nasati bimdinat hayyam" – mevi reaya al haishsha, veen tzarich lehavi reaya al habbanim. umevi reaya al haggedolim, veen tzarich lehavi reaya al hakketannim. bamme devarim amurim: beishsha achat, aval bishte nashim – mevi reaya al haishsha veal habbanim, al haggedolim veal hakketannim.
Amar resh lakish:

a: Lo shanu ella bekodshe haggevul, aval beyuchasin – lo. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu beyuchasin.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: malkin al hachazakot, soklin vesorfin al hachazakot, veen sorfin teruma al hachazakot.
Malkin al hachazakot – kerav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda: huchezka nidda bishchenoteha, balah – loke aleha mishshum nidda.
Soklin vesorfin al hachazakot – kidrabba bar rav huna. deamar rabba bar rav huna: ish veishsha tinok vetinoket shehigdilu betoch habbayit – niskalin ze al ze, venisrafin ze al ze.

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: maase beishsha shebbat lirushalayim vetinok murekav lah al ketefah, vehigdilattu, uva aleha, vehevium levet din usekalum. lo mippene shebbenah vadday, ella mippene shekkaruch achareha.

Veen sorfin teruma al hachazakot – deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: sorfin al hachazakot, verabbi yochanan omer: en sorfin. veazdu letamayyhu, ditnan: tinok shennimtza betzad haissa uvatzek beyado – rabbi meir metaher, vachachamim metammein, mippene sheddarko shel tinok letappeach.

Vehavenan ba: may tameh derabbi meir? kasavar: rov tinokot metappechin, umiut en metappechin, veissa bechezkat tohora omedet, usemoch miuta lachazaka ittera leh rubba. verabbanan: miuta keman deleteh dame, rubba vachazaka – rubba adif.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya: zo hi shessorfin aleha et hatteruma. rabbi yochanan amar: en zo chazaka shessorfin aleha teruma.

Ella ezo chazaka lerabbi yochanan shessorfin aleha et hatteruma? keditnan: issa betoch habbayit, usheratzim utzefardeim mittappelin sham, venimtzeu chatichot baissa. im rov sheratzim – temea. im rov tzefardeim – tehora.
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan: shene devarim en bahem daat lishshael, vaasaum chachamim kema sheyyesh bahem daat lishshael: tinok, veod acheret.
Tinok – ha daamaran. veod acheret may hi? issa betoch habbayit, vetarnegolim umashkim temeim sham, venimtzeu
b: Nikkurim nikkurim baissa – tolin, lo ochlin velo sorfin.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo shanu ella bemashkim levanim, aval bemashkim adummim – im ita dinkir midda yedia. vedilma belatinhu issa?
Amar rabbi yochanan: davar ze shama beribbi, uferusho lo shama: lo shanu ella bemashkim tzelulim, shebbavua shel tinok nikkar bahe[50], aval mashkim achurim – lo.

Mishna lo yityayched adam im shete nashim, aval ishsha achat mityaychedet im shene anashim. rabbi shimon omer: af ish echad mityayched im shete nashim bizman sheishto immo, veyashen immahem befunedki, mippene sheishto meshammarto. mityayched adam im immo veim bitto veyashen immahem bekeruv basar. veim higdilu – zo yeshena bichsutah veze yashen bichsuto.
Gemara may tama? tena deve eliyyahu: hoil venashim datan kallot alehen.
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: remez leyichud min hattora minnayin – shenneemar: "ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha".
Vechi ben em mesit, ben av eno mesit? ella lomar lach: ben mityayched im immo, veasur lehityayched im kol arayot shebbattora.
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv? amar abbaye: la mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya ben av, desane leh veayetz leh etzot raot, ella afillu ben em, dela sane leh – ema tzayyti leh, ka mashma lan.
Nema matnitin dela keabba shaul, detanya: kol sheloshim yom – yotze bechek, venikbar beishsha achat ushene anashim, aval lo beish echad ushete nashim. abba shaul omer: af beish echad ushete nashim.
Afillu tema abba shaul, bishat aninut tevir yitzreh.

Verabbanan savri la kerabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: "ma yitonen adam chay gever al chataav" – afillu bishat aninuto shel adam yitzro mitgabber alav. veabba shaul? ki ketiv hahu – bemitraem al middotav ketiv, vehachi kaamar: ma yitraem al middotav, vechi gavar al chataav? dayyo chayyim shennatatti lo!
Verabbanan? ki hahu maase dehahi itteta dahava ovada veappekteh.

Aval ishsha achat. amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella bichsherim, aval bifrutzim – afillu be asra name la. hava maase, vehotziuha asara bammitta. amar rav yosef: tidda, demichabberi be asra veganvi keshura vela mikkasfi mehadade.
Nema mesayyay leh: mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. talmide chachamim – en, inashe dealma – la? shane talmide chachamim deyadi

a: Leatroye beh.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella bair, aval badderech – ad sheyyihyu shelosha, shemma yitztarech echad mehem lehashetin, venimtza echad mityayched im haerva. nema mesayyay leh: mosrim lo shene talmide chachamim shemma yavo aleha badderech. tere veihu, ha telata! hatam ki hechi denihvo aleh sahadi.

Rav verav yehuda havo kaazli beorcha, hava kaazla hahi itteta kammayyhu. amar leh rav lerav yehuda: dal karaych mikkamme gehinnam. amar leh: veha mar hu deamar bichsherim shappir dame! amar leh: mi yemar devichsherim kegon ana veat? ella kegon may? kegon rabbi chanina bar pappe vachaverav.
Amar rav: malkin al yichud, veen osrin al hayyichud. amar rav ashe: la amaran ella beyichud penuya, aval beyichud deeshet ish – la, shello tehe motzi laaz al baneha.
Mar zutera malke umachrez. amar leh rav nachman mipparhatya lerav ashe: mar name laylke velachrez! amar leh: ikka deshama beha vela shama beha.
Amar rav: malkin al lo tova hashshemua, shenneemar: "al banay ki lo tova hashshemua". mar zutera motev le afsera al katpeh umakre leh: "al banay"

Amar rabba: balah bair – en choshshin mishshum yichud. amar rav yosef: petach patuach lirshut harabbim – en choshshin mishshum yichud. rav bivi ikkela leve rav yosef. batar dichrach rifta amar lehu: shekulu darga mittute bivi. veha amar rabba: balah bair – en choshshin mishshum yichud! shane rav bivi deshoshvinteh havay vegayysa beh.
Amar rav kahana: anashim mibbachutz venashim mibbifnim – en choshshin mishshum yichud. anashim mibbifnim venashim mibbachutz – choshshin mishshum yichud.
Bematnita tana ippecha. amar abbaye: hasheta deamar rav kahana hachi vetana matnita ippecha, ana naaved lechumera.
Abbaye dayayr gulefe. rava dayayr kene. amar avin: sekava deshatta rigla.

Hanach shevuyayta daatay linhardea. assekinhu leve rav amram chasida, ashkulu darga mikkammayyhu. bahade deka chalfa chada minnayyhu nefal nehora beippumma. shakleh rav amram ledarga dela havo yachlin be asra lemidleyeh, dalyeh lechodeh, salek veazel.

Ki meta lefalga [d]darga ippeshach, rema kala: nura be amram! ato rabbanan, amaru leh: kasseftinan. amar lehu: mutav tikkasfu be amram bealma haden vela tikkasfu minneh lealma deate. ashbeeh deyinpak minneh, nefak minneh ki ammuda denura. amar leh: chazi, deat nura vaana bisra, vaana adifna minnach.

Rabbi meir hava mitlotzetz beovre avera. yoma chad iddemi leh satan keitteta behach gisa denahara, la hava mabbara – nekat mitzra veka avar. ki meta palga mitzra shavkeh, amar: i lav deka machrezi birkia "hizzaharu berabbi meir vetorato" shavveteh lidmach tarte mae.

Rabbi akiva hava mitlotzetz beovre avera. yoma chad iddemi leh satan keitteta beresh dikla. nakteh ledikla vekasalek veazel. ki meta lefalgeh dedikla shavkeh, amar: i lav demachrezi birkia "hizzaharu berabbi akiva vetorato" shavveteh lidmach tarte mae.

Pelemo hava regil lememar kol yoma "gira beeneh desatan". yoma chad maale yoma dechippure hava. iddemi leh keanya. ata kera abbava, appiku leh rifta. amar leh: yoma ki haiddana kulle alma gavvay vaana abbaray? ayyeyleh vekarivu leh rifta. amar leh: yoma ki haiddana kulle alma attakka vaana lechoday? atyu otvu attakka. hava yatev mela nafsheh shichna vechive (aleh) vahava kaaved beh mille dimis. amar leh:
b: Tiv shappir. amar leh: havu li kasa, yehavu leh kasa. achmar sheda beh kicho. necharu beh. sheka umit. shemau dahavo kaamri: pelemo ketal gavra! pelemo ketal gavra! arak utesha nafsheh bevet hakkisse. azel batreh, nefal kammeh. ki dechazyeh dahava mitztaar galli leh nafsheh. amar leh: may tama amrat hachi? veella hechi ema? amar leh: lema mar "rachamana nigar beh besatan".

Rabbi chiyyay bar ashe hava regil kol iddan dahava nafel leappeh hava amar: "harachaman yatztzilenu miyyetzer hara". yoma chad (shematinhu) [shemateh] devethu, amara: mikkede ha kamma shene defaresh leh minnay, may tama kaamar hachi?

Yoma chada hava ka gares beginneteh. kashshita nafsha, chalfa vetanyay kammeh. amar la: man at? amara: ana charuta dahadari miyyoma. tava. amara leh: ayyti nihalay lehach rummana deresh tzutzita. shevavr, azal atyeh nihala.

Ki ata leveteh hava ka shagra devethu tannura, salek veka yatev begavveh. amara leh: may hay? amar la: hachi vehachi hava maase. amra leh: ana havay. la ashgach ba, ad dihava leh simane. amar la: ana miha leissura ikkavvavni. kol yamav shel oto tzaddik haya mitanne ad shemmet beotah mita.
Detanya: "ishah haferam vaAdonai yislach lah", bamma hakkatuv medabber? beishsha shennadra benazir, veshama balah vehefer lah, vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah, vehayta shota yayin umittammea lemetim.

Rabbi akiva ki hava mate lehay pesuka hava bache, amar: uma mi shennitkavven leechol besar chazir veala beyado besar tale, amra tora: tzericha kappara uselicha, mi shennitkavven leechol besar chazir veala beyado besar chazir – al achat kamma vechamma.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer "velo yada veashem venasa avono". keshehaya rabbi akiva maggia lefasuk ze haya boche: uma mi shennitkavven leechol shumman veala beyado chelev – amra tora: "velo yada veashem venasa avono", mi shennitkavven leechol chelev veala beyado chelev – al achat kamma vechamma. isi ben yehuda omer: "velo yada veashem venasa avono" – al davar ze yidvu kol haddovim.

Mityayched adam im immo. amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: mityayched adam im achoto, vedar im immo veim bitto. ki amri[yta] kammeh dishmuel, amar: asur lehityayched im kol arayot shebbattora, vaafillu im behema.

Tenan: mityayched adam im immo veim bitto veyashen immahem bekeruv basar, uteyuveta dishmuel! amar lach shemuel: velitamaych, ha detanya: achoto vachamoto ushear kol arayot shebbattora en mityayched immahem ella beedim. beedim – in, shello beedim – la!

Ella tannae hi. detanya, amar rabbi meir: hizzaharu bi mippene bitti. amar rabbi tarfon: hizzaharu bi mippene kallati. ligleg alav oto talmid. amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel: lo hayu yamim muatim ad shennichshal oto talmid bachamoto.

Afillu im behema abbaye mechalle[10] leh mikkulle davra. rav sheshet meabbar leh mitzra. rav chanan minnehardea ikkela lerav kahana lefum nahara. chazyeh deyatev veka gares vekayyma behema kammeh. amar leh: la savar la mar afillu im behema? amar leh: lav addatay.
Amar rava: mityayched adam im shete yevamot veim shete tzarot, im ishsha vachamotah, im ishsha uvat balah, im ishsha vetinoket sheyyodaat taam bia, veen moseret atzmah levia.

Higdilu ze yashen bichsuto vechulei. vechamma? amar rav adda bar rav (uzza) [avva] amar rav assi: tinoket bat tesha shanim veyom echad, tinok ben shetem esre shana veyom echad. ikka deamri: tinoket bat shetem esre shana veyom echad, tinok ben shelosh esre veyom echad, veze veze kede sheyyihyu "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach".
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella sheenah bosha laamod lefanav arumma, aval bosha laamod lefanav arumma – asur. may tama – yetzer albesha.

Rav acha bar abba ikkela leve rav chisda chatneh. shakleh levat beratte otva bechanfeh. amar leh: la savar la mar demikkaddesha? amar leh: avart lach adderav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi elazar: asur leadam sheyyekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna, ad shettagdil vetomar: "bifloni ani rotza". mar name avar leh addishmuel, deamar shemuel: en mishtammeshim beishsha! amar leh: ana keiddach dishmuel sevira li, deamar shemuel:

a: Hakkol leshem shamayim.

Mishna lo yelammed adam rauok sofrim. velo telammed ishsha sofrim. rabbi elazar omer: af mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed sofrim. rabbi yehuda omer: lo yire rauok behema, velo yishnu shene rauokin betallit achat, vachachamim mattirim.

Gemara may tama? illema mishshum yanoke, vehatanya: amru lo lerabbi yehuda: lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zechur velo al habbehema! ella: rauok – mishshum immahata deyanoke. ishsha – mishshum avahata deyanoke.
Rabbi elazar omer af mi sheen kulei. ibbaya lehu: mi sheen lo ishsha kelal, o dilma besheenah sheruya etzlo? ta shema: af mi sheyyesh lo veenah sheruya etzlo lo yelammed sofrim.
Rabbi yehuda omer lo yire kulei. tanya: amru lo lerabbi yehuda: lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zechur velo al habbehema.

Mishna kol sheasakav im hannashim lo yityached im hannashim, velo yelammed adam et beno ummanut hannashim. rabbi meir omer: leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla, veyitpallel lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello. sheen ummanut sheen bah aniyyut vaashirut, shello aniyyut min haummanut, velo ashirut min haummanut, ella hakkol lefi zechuto.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: raita miyyamecha chayya vaof sheyyesh lahem ummanut? vehen mitparnesin shello betzaar! vahalo lo nivreu ella leshammesheni, vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni, eno din sheetparnes shello betzaar? ella shehorati maasay, vekippachti et parnasati.

Abba gureyayn ish tzayydan omer mishshum abba gureya: lo yelammed adam et beno chammar, gammal, kaddar, sappan, roe, vechenvani – sheummanutan ummanut listim. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: hachammarin rubban reshaim, vehaggammalin rubban kesherin, hassappanin rubban chasidim. tov shebbarofim – legehinnam, vehakkasher shebbattabbachim – shuttafo shel amalek.

Rabbi nehoray omer: manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora, sheadam ochel missecharah baolam hazze, vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, ushear kol ummaniyyot enan ken. kesheadam ba lide choli o lide zikna o lide yissurin, veeno yachol laasok bimlachto – hare hu met baraav. aval hattora enah ken, ella meshammarto mikkol ra benaaruto, venotenet lo acharit vetikva beziknuto.

Benaaruto mahu omer? "vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach". beziknuto mahu omer? "od yenuvun beseva", vechen hu omer beavraham avinu: "veavraham zaken... vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol" – matzinu sheasa avraham avinu et kol hattora kullah ad shello nittena, shenneemar: "ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukkotay vetorotay"

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol sheasakav im hannashim – soro ra, kegon hatztzorfim, vehassarekim, vehannakorot, veharochlin, vehaggardiyyim, vehassapparim vehakkovsim, vehaggara, vehabballan, vehabbureski – en maamidim mehem lo melech velo kohen gadol. may tama? la mishshum difsili, ella mishshum dezil ummanutayhu.

Tanu rabbanan: asara devarim neemru begara: mehallech al tziddo, verucho gassa, venitle veyoshev, veeno tzara, veeno raa, ochel harebe umotzi kima, vechashud al haarayot veal haggazel veal shefichut damim.
Darash bar kappara: leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla. may hi? amar rav yehuda:
b: Machta detalmiyyuta.

Tanya, rabbi omer: en lecha ummanut sheoveret min haolam. ashre mi sheroe et horav beummanut meulla, oy lo lemi sheroe et horav beummanut peguma. i efshar laolam belo bassam uvelo bureski. ashre mi sheummanuto bassam, veoy lo [l]mi sheummanuto bureski. i efshar leolam belo zecharim uvelo nekevot, ashre mi shebbanav zecharim veoy lo lemi shebbanav nekevot.

Rabbi meir omer: leolam yelammed adam livno ummanut nekiyya vekalla, vivakkesh rachamim lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello, sheen aniyyut min haummanut veen ashirut min haummanut, ella – lemi shehaosher shello, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot".

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im raita miyyamecha. tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: miyyamay lo raiti tzevi kayyaytz, vaari sabbal, veshual chenvani, vehem mitparnesim shello betzaar. vehem lo nivreu ella leshammesheni, vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni. ma ellu shello nivreu ella leshammesheni mitparnesim shello betzaar, vaani shennivreti leshammesh et koni – eno din sheetparnes shello betzaar? ella shehareoti et maasay vekippachti et parnasati, shenneemar: "avonotechem hittu".

Rabbi nehoray omer: manniach ani kol ummanut vechulei. tanya: rabbi nehoray omer: manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora, shekkol ummanut shebbaolam en omedet lo ella bime yalduto, aval bime ziknuto hare hu muttal baraav. aval tora enah ken – omedet lo laadam beet yalduto, venotenet lo acharit vetikva beet ziknuto. beet yalduto mahu omer? "vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu ever kannesharim" beziknuto mahu omer? "od yenuvun beseva deshenim veraanannim yihyu".
Hadaran alach asara yuchasin uselika la massechet kiddushin

a: Mishna arbaa avot nezikin: hashshor, vehabbor, vehammave, vehahever.
Lo hare hashshor kahare hammave, velo hare hammave kahare hashshor; velo ze vaze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim, kahare haesh sheen bo ruach chayyim;
Velo ze vaze sheddarkan lelech ulehazzik, kahare habbor sheen darko lelech ulehazzik.
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheddarkan lehazzik, ushemiratan alecha; ucheshehizzik – chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek, bemetav haaretz.
Gemara middekatane "avot" – mikkelal deikka toldot; toldotehen kayyotze bahen, o lav kayyotze bahen?
Gabbe shabbat tenan: avot melachot – arbaim chaser achat. "avot" – mikkelal deikka toladot,
Toldotehen kayyotze bahen; la shena av – chattat, vela shena tolada – chattat; la shena av – sekila, vela shena tolada – sekila.

Umay ikka ben av letolada? nafka minna, deillu aved shete avot bahade hadade, i name shete toladot bahade hadade – michayyayv akkol chada vachada; veillu aved av vetolada dideh – la michayyayv ella chada.
Ulerabbi eliezer – dimchayyev attolada bimkom av; ammay kare leh av, veammay kare la tolada? hach dahava bemishkan chashiva – kare leh av, hach dela have bemishkan chashiva – kare la tolada.
Gabbay tumeot tenan: avot hattumeot – hashsheretz, vehashichvat zera,
b: Uteme met. toldotehen lav kayyotze bahen; deillu av – metamme adam vechelim, veillu toladot – ochalin umashkin metamme, adam vechelim lo metamme.
Hacha may? amar rav pappa: yesh mehen kayyotze bahen, veyesh mehen lav kayyotze bahen.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha avot neemru beshor – hakkeren, vehashshen, veharegel.

Keren menalan? detanu rabbanan: "ki yiggach" – en negicha ella keren, shenneemar: "vayyaas lo tzidkiyya ven kenaana karne varzel, vayyomer: ko amar Adonai, beelle tenaggach et aram vegomer". veomer: "bechor shoro hadar lo, vekarne reem karnav, bahem ammim yenaggach".
May "veomer"? vechi tema divre tora middivre kabbala la yalfinan, ta shema: "bechor shoro hadar lo".
Vehay melaf hu?! gilluy milleta bealma hu, dingicha bekeren hu!
Ella mahu detema, ki palleg rachamana ben tam lemuad – hane mille bitlusha, aval bimchubberet – ema kullah muedet hi;
Ta shema: "bechor shoro hadar lo vegomer".
Tolada dekeren may hi? negifa, neshicha, revitza, uveita.
May shena negicha dekare la av – dichtiv "ki yiggach", negifa name ketiv "ki yiggof"! hay negifa – negicha hi. detanya: patach bingifa" vesiyyem bingicha", lomar lach: zo hi negifa zo hi negicha.
May shena gabbe adam dichtiv "ki yiggach", umay shena gabbe behema dichtiv "ki yiggof"?
Adam – deit leh mazzala, ketiv "ki yiggach"; behema – delet la mazzala, ketiv "ki yiggof".
Umilleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan – demuad leadam have muad livhema umuad livhema la have muad leadam.
Neshicha – tolada deshen hi! la; shen – yesh hanaa lehezzekah, ha – en hanaa lehezzekah.
Revitza uveita – tolada deregel hi! la; regel – hezzekah matzuy, hane – en hezzekan matzuy.
Ella "toldotehen lav kayyotze bahen" deamar rav pappa, aheyay?
Illema ahane; may shena keren – dechauonato lehazzik, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – kauonatan lehazzik, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha!
Ella tolada dekeren kekeren, vechi kaamar rav pappa – ashshen varegel.
Shen varegel hecha ketivi? detanya: "veshillach" – ze haregel, vechen hu omer: "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor".
